tatooine.name: Tatooine
tatooine.bio: A desert world baking under two suns, far from the heart of the galaxy. With almost no surface water, its people farm moisture from the air, trade in junk and scrap, and live under the shadow of the Hutt crime lords who run the place. Podracing, Jawa sandcrawlers, Tusken Raiders and the wretched hive of Mos Eisley all call it home. It is where Anakin Skywalker grew up a slave, where Obi-Wan Kenobi kept watch in exile, and where Luke Skywalker stared at the twin sunset and dreamed of something more.

alderaan.name: Alderaan
alderaan.bio: A peaceful, beautiful Core World of green plains and snow-capped mountains, known for its art, culture and its refusal to keep weapons. Home of the royal House of Organa, it raised Princess Leia after Bail and Breha Organa adopted her. Alderaan quietly supported the growing Rebellion, and paid for it: Grand Moff Tarkin chose it as the first target of the Death Star's superlaser, destroying the entire planet in a single shot to show the galaxy what resistance would cost.

yavin-4.name: Yavin 4
yavin-4.bio: A jungle-covered moon circling the orange gas giant Yavin. Ancient stone temples, built long ago by the vanished Massassi people, rise above the treetops. The Rebel Alliance hid its main base inside the largest of them, and it was from here that X-wings and Y-wings launched to attack the first Death Star. Luke Skywalker's one-in-a-million shot saved the moon, and the medal ceremony in the temple's great hall closed the battle that changed the war.

hoth.name: Hoth
hoth.bio: A remote ice world battered by blizzards, where nights get cold enough to kill a person in hours. Its only notable natives are the tauntauns the rebels rode and the wampas that hunted them. The Rebel Alliance carved Echo Base into its glaciers, hoping nobody would look this far out. An Imperial probe droid found them anyway, and Darth Vader's AT-AT walkers marched across the snowfields in one of the Empire's greatest victories of the war.

dagobah.name: Dagobah
dagobah.bio: A misty swamp world thick with twisted trees, bogs and creatures, and almost no technology at all. Its overwhelming life gives it a strong presence in the Force, which made it the perfect hiding place for Jedi Master Yoda after the fall of the Republic. Here he trained Luke Skywalker, lifted his X-wing out of the swamp and sent him into the dark-side cave, and here, years later, he finally passed into the Force.

bespin.name: Bespin
bespin.bio: A huge gas giant with a thin band of breathable air high in its pink and orange clouds. Floating there is Cloud City, a mining colony that skims valuable Tibanna gas, run by the smooth-talking administrator Lando Calrissian. It looked like a safe harbour for Han, Leia and Chewbacca, until Darth Vader arrived first. Han was frozen in carbonite, and in the depths of the city Luke lost his hand and learned the truth about his father.

endor.name: Endor
endor.bio: The forest moon of Endor, a green world of giant trees orbiting a gas giant, home to the small but fierce Ewoks in their treetop villages. The Empire protected the second Death Star with a shield generator built here. A strike team led by Han Solo and Leia, with Ewoks hurling rocks and swinging logs, brought down the shield while the rebel fleet attacked above. The celebration in the Ewok village marked the end of the Emperor.

kashyyyk.name: Kashyyyk
kashyyyk.terrain: Forests of wroshyr trees, wetlands, coasts
kashyyyk.bio: The forest homeworld of the Wookiees, covered in towering wroshyr trees with whole cities built high in their branches. Wookiees are strong, loyal and long-lived; Chewbacca was born here. During the Clone Wars, Yoda led clone troopers alongside Wookiee warriors against the droid army on its shores, until Order 66 turned the clones on him. Under the Empire many Wookiees were enslaved, and Kashyyyk became a symbol of the Empire's cruelty.

naboo.name: Naboo
naboo.bio: A lush green world of lakes, meadows and graceful domed cities, shared by the human Naboo and the Gungans living in bubble cities underwater. Its elected Queen Padmé Amidala faced the Trade Federation's invasion and won it back with the Gungan army's help. Naboo is also where a quiet senator named Sheev Palpatine came from. Padmé and Anakin married in secret by one of its lakes, and the whole planet mourned at her funeral.

coruscant.name: Coruscant
coruscant.bio: The capital of the galaxy, a planet covered from pole to pole by one endless city of skyscrapers thousands of levels deep, with air traffic streaming between the towers. It held the Galactic Senate and the Jedi Temple for a thousand generations. Its glittering upper levels hide dangerous underworld streets far below. As the Republic became the Empire, the Temple was stormed in Order 66 and Coruscant became the Imperial Center.

kamino.name: Kamino
kamino.bio: An ocean world lashed by endless rain and storms, hidden just beyond the galaxy's edge and deleted from the Jedi Archives. The tall, elegant Kaminoans live in cities raised on stilts above the waves and are famous for one thing: cloning. Obi-Wan Kenobi found an army of clone troopers being grown here from the bounty hunter Jango Fett, secretly ordered for the Republic ten years earlier. That army fought the Clone Wars.

geonosis.name: Geonosis
geonosis.bio: A harsh red desert planet circled by a ring of asteroids, home to the winged insect-like Geonosians who live in towering hives and run vast droid factories. Count Dooku gathered the Separatist leaders here. Obi-Wan, Anakin and Padmé were sentenced to death in its execution arena, and the Jedi charged in to rescue them. When the clone army arrived to finish the battle, the Clone Wars had begun.

utapau.name: Utapau
utapau.bio: A dry, windswept world dotted with huge sinkholes, where cities cling to the walls of the pits and the tall Pau'ans and short Utai live side by side. General Grievous hid the Separatist Council here near the end of the Clone Wars. Obi-Wan Kenobi rode a lizard-like varactyl after him through the city and finally defeated him, just before the clone troopers were ordered to turn on the Jedi.

cato-neimoidia.name: Cato Neimoidia
cato-neimoidia.bio: One of the wealthy colony worlds of the Neimoidians, the species behind the Trade Federation. Their ornate bridge cities hang beneath vast natural rock arches over misty chasms. During the Clone Wars it was a Separatist stronghold, and it was here that Jedi Master Plo Koon was flying with his clone pilots when Order 66 came through and his own wingmen shot him down.

mygeeto.name: Mygeeto
mygeeto.bio: A frozen world of glittering crystal and huge cities, home to the vaults of the InterGalactic Banking Clan, one of the Separatists' richest backers. Late in the Clone Wars, Jedi Master Ki-Adi-Mundi led clone troopers in a battle across a broken bridge in its icy ruins. When Order 66 was given, his troopers turned and gunned him down mid-charge.

saleucami.name: Saleucami
saleucami.bio: A hot Outer Rim world pocked with craters and dotted with strange plant life, where the Separatists retreated late in the Clone Wars. The Republic besieged it, and Jedi Master Stass Allie was riding a speeder bike on patrol when Order 66 was given. The clone troopers riding behind her opened fire. Saleucami is also where the clone deserter Cut Lawquane settled down with a farm and a family.

felucia.name: Felucia
felucia.bio: A strange and colourful jungle world of giant mushrooms, glowing plants and enormous flowers, many of them hungry. It changed hands many times during the Clone Wars. Jedi Master Aayla Secura was marching through its jungles with Commander Bly and his clone troopers when Order 66 came through, and Bly's men shot her in the back. Few planets look as alien, or as beautiful.

mustafar.name: Mustafar
mustafar.bio: A small fiery world of erupting volcanoes and rivers of lava, mined for its rare minerals. Anakin Skywalker, newly turned Darth Vader, killed the Separatist leaders here, and then fought Obi-Wan Kenobi across a collapsing mining complex. He was left burning on its black sands, and survived only inside his suit. Years later Vader built his dark castle on Mustafar, over a place strong in the dark side.

polis-massa.name: Polis Massa
polis-massa.bio: The broken remains of a planet that shattered long ago, now a field of asteroids. The Kallidahin, quiet researchers, built a medical and archaeological station here to study the lost world. After Mustafar, Obi-Wan and Yoda brought Padmé to the station in secret, where she gave birth to Luke and Leia and died. It was here that Yoda, Obi-Wan and Bail Organa decided to split up the twins and hide them.

mandalore.name: Mandalore
mandalore.bio: The homeworld of the Mandalorians, a culture of warriors famous for their armour, their jetpacks and their code. By the Clone Wars, Mandalore had become a peaceful world ruled from its domed capital, Sundari, until Maul and the Death Watch took over. At the end of the war, Ahsoka Tano and Republic clones besieged the planet to capture Maul, and Order 66 arrived in the middle of it. Later the Empire bombed Mandalore into ruin.

jakku.name: Jakku
jakku.bio: A harsh desert world littered with the wreckage of huge Star Destroyers and rebel ships, left over from the last great battle of the Galactic Civil War. Scavengers make a living stripping the wrecks for parts and trading them for food portions at Niima Outpost. Rey grew up alone here waiting for her family to return, until she met BB-8, Finn and an old ship called the Millennium Falcon.

takodana.name: Takodana
takodana.bio: A green, peaceful world of forests and lakes, best known for Maz Kanata's castle, a neutral meeting place for smugglers, pirates and travellers that she has kept for a thousand years. Han Solo brought Rey, Finn and BB-8 here for help. In its vaults Rey found Luke's old lightsaber and had her first vision. Then the First Order attacked, and the castle was destroyed.

d-qar.name: D'Qar
d-qar.bio: A green, quiet world in the Outer Rim that hid the main base of General Leia Organa's Resistance. Poe Dameron's X-wings launched from here to destroy Starkiller Base. Not long after, the First Order found the base, and the Resistance had to flee while its bombers attacked a dreadnought above the planet, the desperate escape that begins the chase across the galaxy.

hosnian-prime.name: Hosnian Prime
hosnian-prime.bio: A city-covered Core World that became the capital of the New Republic in the years after the Empire fell, home to its Senate. The New Republic thought the First Order was just a nuisance. The First Order proved otherwise: Starkiller Base fired across the galaxy and destroyed Hosnian Prime and its whole star system, wiping out the Republic's government and fleet in a single moment.

ilum.name: Starkiller Base (Ilum)
ilum.bio: Once Ilum, a sacred snow planet where young Jedi went to find the kyber crystals for their first lightsabers. Decades later, the First Order hollowed it out and turned it into Starkiller Base, a superweapon able to drain a star and fire across the galaxy. It destroyed the Hosnian system before the Resistance attacked. Han Solo died on its bridge, and Rey and Finn fought Kylo Ren in its snowy forest as the planet tore itself apart.

ahch-to.name: Ahch-To
ahch-to.bio: A remote ocean world of rocky green islands, home to the very first Jedi Temple, where the Jedi Order began. Luke Skywalker went into exile here with his X-wing at the bottom of the sea, living alongside the porgs and the Lanai caretakers. Rey found him at the top of the island's steps and convinced him, slowly, to teach her. It is also where Luke made his final stand from across the galaxy.

lah-mu.name: Lah'mu
lah-mu.bio: A quiet, rainy farm world of black volcanic soil and grassy plains on the edge of the galaxy. The scientist Galen Erso hid here with his wife Lyra and their daughter Jyn to escape the Empire's weapons programme. Director Orson Krennic found them anyway, killed Lyra and took Galen back to finish the Death Star. Little Jyn hid in a cave until Saw Gerrera came for her.

wobani.name: Wobani
wobani.bio: A grim, muddy Imperial prison world where prisoners work in labour camps under heavy guard. Jyn Erso was being held here under a false name when a Rebel team led by Cassian Andor and the reprogrammed droid K-2SO broke her out of a transport, because the Rebellion needed her help to reach her father's old friend Saw Gerrera.

jedha.name: Jedha
jedha.bio: A cold desert moon and one of the galaxy's oldest holy places, where pilgrims of many faiths, including believers in the Force, came to Jedha City. The Empire occupied it to strip out its kyber crystals, the heart of the Death Star's weapon. Saw Gerrera's partisans fought the Empire in its streets. Tarkin then tested the Death Star on Jedha City, wiping it from the face of the moon.

eadu.name: Eadu
eadu.bio: A dark, storm-lashed world of jagged rock where rain hardly ever stops. The Empire built a research base on a landing platform here where Galen Erso and his scientists worked on the Death Star. Jyn Erso went to find her father, but a Rebel bombing raid hit the base and Galen died in her arms in the rain, after Krennic had already executed his team.

scarif.name: Scarif
scarif.bio: A tropical paradise of turquoise lagoons and palm-covered islands, protected by a shield gate. It hid the Empire's main data vault, the Citadel, holding the Death Star plans. Jyn Erso, Cassian Andor and Rogue One fought their way onto its beaches with Rebel fleet support to steal the plans, and none of them came home. The Death Star fired on the Citadel, but the plans were already on their way to Princess Leia.

cantonica.name: Cantonica (Canto Bight)
cantonica.bio: A desert planet turned into a playground for the super-rich, built around Canto Bight, a glittering casino city by an artificial sea. Its wealthy guests made their money selling weapons to both sides of the war, and children work in its stables caring for the racing fathiers. Finn and Rose came here looking for a codebreaker, and ended up freeing the fathiers in a stampede through the city.

crait.name: Crait
crait.terrain: Salt flats over red mineral soil
crait.bio: A small mineral world covered in white salt that leaves a red trail where anything moves across it. The Rebellion once had an old outpost here, and the last of the Resistance took shelter in it after fleeing D'Qar. The First Order came with walkers and a battering ram cannon. Luke Skywalker walked out alone to face Kylo Ren, buying time for the Resistance to escape.

corellia.name: Corellia
corellia.bio: An industrial Core World famous for its shipyards, which have built many of the galaxy's starships, from Corellian corvettes to the YT-1300 freighter that became the Millennium Falcon. Its gritty streets are run by gangs, and young street thieves work for the likes of Lady Proxima. Han Solo grew up here, and fled by joining the Imperial Navy, leaving Qi'ra behind. Corellians are known as great pilots, and stubborn ones.

mimban.name: Mimban
mimban.bio: A grey, muddy world wrapped in fog where the Empire fought a long, miserable war against the locals to take its minerals. Han Solo served as an infantryman in its trenches after being thrown out of flight school. In the mud he met Tobias Beckett's crew, and was thrown into a pit with a 'beast' that turned out to be a Wookiee named Chewbacca.

vandor.name: Vandor
vandor.bio: A cold world of snowy peaks and frozen lakes, a quiet stop on the edge of nowhere. Tobias Beckett's crew, with Han and Chewbacca, tried to steal a cargo of coaxium from an Imperial conveyor train winding through its mountains. Enfys Nest's raiders arrived, the train went over a cliff, and Beckett's crew lost the cargo and some of its own, leaving them in debt to Dryden Vos.

kessel.name: Kessel
kessel.bio: A poisoned mining world near a black hole cluster called the Maw. Slaves and droids dig up its rare spice for the Pyke Syndicate. Han, Chewbacca, Lando and L3-37 raided its mines to steal unrefined coaxium, then fled through the Maw on the Kessel Run, the famous route Han made in 'less than twelve parsecs' by taking a dangerous short cut in the Millennium Falcon.

savareen.name: Savareen
savareen.bio: A dry, windswept planet on the edge of a sea, where a small community runs an old coaxium refinery. Han and Chewbacca landed the battered Millennium Falcon here to refine the stolen fuel. The deal turned into a showdown: Enfys Nest's real mission was revealed, Beckett betrayed Han, and on these sands Han Solo shot first.

ajan-kloss.name: Ajan Kloss
ajan-kloss.bio: A jungle moon of thick forest and hidden caves. Years earlier, Leia trained here as a Jedi under her brother Luke. Later it became the final base of the Resistance, where Rey continued her training with Leia, and where the Resistance gathered its last ships before flying to Exegol. Leia died here, at peace, after reaching out to her son Ben one last time.

exegol.name: Exegol
exegol.bio: A dark, hidden world deep in the Unknown Regions, wrapped in lightning storms and hard to find without a Sith wayfinder. It was the secret home of the Sith Eternal, the cult that kept Palpatine alive and built his fleet of planet-killing Star Destroyers. Rey faced the Emperor in the ancient Sith citadel here, while ordinary people across the galaxy flew in to fight his fleet.

pasaana.name: Pasaana
pasaana.bio: A desert world of red canyons and sand, home of the cheerful Aki-Aki people, who celebrate a festival of colours once every 42 years. Rey, Finn, Poe and Chewbacca arrived during the festival, looking for clues to Exegol. They found Lando Calrissian, the abandoned ship of a Sith hunter and a dagger, and Rey fought Kylo Ren's TIE fighter in the desert with a single cut.

kijimi.name: Kijimi
kijimi.bio: A cold, snowy mountain world with a crowded city built into the cliffs, full of thieves and smugglers. It is where Poe Dameron once ran spice, and where his old partner Zorii Bliss still worked. The team came here to find a droidsmith to crack a message in C-3PO's memory. Shortly after they left, the First Order destroyed Kijimi with one of its new Star Destroyers.

kef-bir.name: Kef Bir
kef-bir.bio: An ocean moon in the Endor system with crashing waves and grassy cliffs. The wreckage of the second Death Star fell here and is still rusting in the sea. Rey went inside it to find the Emperor's wayfinder, then fought Kylo Ren on its broken hull among the huge waves. As Leia called out to her son, Rey ran him through, then healed him.

nevarro.name: Nevarro
nevarro.bio: A volcanic world of black rock and lava rivers on the Hydian Way. After the Empire fell, its city became a haven for bounty hunters working through Greef Karga's Guild. It is where Din Djarin, the Mandalorian, took the job that led him to Grogu. Karga later cleaned up the town and turned Nevarro into a thriving trading port, and its people never forgot Din and Grogu.

nal-hutta.name: Nal Hutta
nal-hutta.bio: The homeworld of the Hutts, a hot, steamy planet of swamps and greasy rain deep in Hutt Space, far from galactic law. The Grand Hutt Council of the most powerful crime families rules from its palaces, and it has long been a refuge for smugglers, bounty hunters and anyone who wants to stay out of reach of the Republic. Jabba the Hutt was a member of one of its great clans.

nar-shaddaa.name: Nar Shaddaa
nar-shaddaa.bio: The 'Smuggler's Moon', circling Nal Hutta. Its entire surface is one vertical city of neon, towers and grime, a darker cousin of Coruscant run by Hutt crime lords. Smugglers, bounty hunters and gangsters of every kind do business in its crowded streets, and anything can be bought there. It was home to the bounty hunter Aurra Sing.

adelphi.name: Adelphi
adelphi.bio: A warm coastal world of beaches and jungle in the Outer Rim. In the early days of the New Republic it hosted one of its outposts, home of the Adelphi Rangers, the X-wing squadron of pilots such as Captain Carson Teva, who kept watch on the lawless edges of the galaxy as Imperial warlords lingered in the shadows.

shakari.name: Shakari
shakari.bio: A small moon in the Shakari system of the Outer Rim. In the days of the New Republic it was quietly in the grip of the Imperial warlord Janu Coin. Din Djarin and Grogu, with the Lasat rebel veteran Zeb Orrelios, came looking for Rotta the Hutt, and picked up a lead from Hugo Durant, a fry cook working his little food stand.

phostera.name: Phostera
phostera.bio: A frozen, mountainous world where, after the Battle of Jakku, the Imperial remnant of Commander Barro hid in a base and ran the local towns like his own kingdom, squeezing them for protection money. The Mandalorian, Din Djarin, working as a bounty hunter for the New Republic, raided Barro's stronghold and brought his rule to an end.

daiyu.name: Daiyu
daiyu.bio: A rainy, crowded world under the Empire's control, where its main city glows with neon signs and noodle stalls and is crawling with spice dealers, fake Jedi and bounty hunters. Obi-Wan Kenobi left Tatooine for the first time in ten years to come here when young Leia Organa was kidnapped and held in the city, and he had to rescue her while Inquisitors hunted him.

mapuzo.name: Mapuzo
mapuzo.bio: Once a lush, living world, Mapuzo had been stripped into a dusty wasteland by Imperial mining. Obi-Wan and Leia fled here from Daiyu on a cargo transport and found help from Tala, an Imperial officer secretly working with the Path, a network smuggling Jedi to safety. It is also where Darth Vader caught up with his old master for the first time in ten years, and dragged him through fire.

nur.name: Nur
nur.bio: An ocean moon in the Mustafar system, covered in deep water with no land at all. The Empire built the Fortress Inquisitorius here, a grim underwater stronghold for the Inquisitors who hunted the last Jedi, where captured Jedi were held in its depths. Young Leia was taken here as a prisoner, and Obi-Wan slipped into the fortress to get her out.

jabiim.name: Jabiim
jabiim.bio: An obscure, rocky mining world in the Outer Rim. In the time of the Empire, a hidden base of the Path, a secret network that smuggled Jedi and other Force-sensitives away from the Inquisitors, was run here by Tala Durith and Roken. Obi-Wan and Leia led the refugees here, and a few brave people held off the Inquisitors so the rest could escape.

arcana.name: Arcana
arcana.bio: A barren world holding an ancient stronghold built by the Nightsisters of Dathomir thousands of years ago. Inside, Ahsoka Tano found a puzzle-locked star map believed to show the way to Grand Admiral Thrawn, who had vanished from the galaxy. Retrieving it set off a race between Ahsoka and Morgan Elsbeth's allies that ended in another galaxy.

seatos.name: Seatos
seatos.bio: A world of forests and seas with mysterious ruins built by an ancient species from another galaxy. The ruins hid a giant hyperspace ring meant to carry travellers to another galaxy, powered by the star map. Ahsoka followed Morgan Elsbeth here, Sabine Wren and Ahsoka fought Baylan Skoll and Shin Hati, and Sabine traded the map for the chance to find Ezra.

peridea.name: Peridea
peridea.bio: A planet in a whole other galaxy, ringed by the bones of the giant space whales called purrgil. Jedi children told legends of it. It was once the heart of an old witch kingdom of the Dathomiri, now in ruins, and home of the little Noti people. Ezra Bridger and Grand Admiral Thrawn were stranded here after Lothal was freed, until Sabine and Ahsoka came.

lothal.name: Lothal
lothal.bio: A rolling grassland world with tall rock spires, once a farming planet before the Empire scarred it with factories. It was home to Ezra Bridger and the rebel crew of the Ghost, who freed it from the Empire. Ezra disappeared with Grand Admiral Thrawn in the battle, and years later Hera, Sabine and Ahsoka looked out from Lothal, still waiting for him to come home.

dathomir.name: Dathomir
dathomir.bio: A blood-red world of twisted forests and swamps, home to the Nightsisters, witches who wield a dark magic, and their Nightbrothers. Darth Maul and Savage Opress came from here. Count Dooku's droids wiped out most of the Nightsisters during the Clone Wars, but their magic lingered, and Morgan Elsbeth's people believed it could bring back those who were thought lost.

at-attin.name: At Attin
at-attin.bio: A hidden planet of tidy towns and woods, sealed behind a barrier that blocks out the stars, where people work as 'analysts' in the Great Work of the Old Republic. To the rest of the galaxy it is a legend: a treasure world full of riches. Wim, Neel, Fern and KB come from here, and when they stumble on a buried starship they set off pirates and all on a trail back home.

borgo-prime.name: Borgo Prime
borgo-prime.bio: Starport Borgo, a pirate haven built into an asteroid on the Braxant Run, with crowded markets, dodgy cantinas and docks where almost anything can be bought or sold. Maz Kanata marked it on a smugglers' map long ago. The At Attin kids landed here aboard the Onyx Cinder, a long way from home, in a port run by pirates.

lanupa.name: Lanupa
lanupa.bio: A cold mountain world once known as Battle World. Its Skull Ridge Mountain was a terrifying pirate stronghold with acid baths and fighting pits, until it was turned into a luxury hotel and spa with mud baths, bacta soaks and buffets, much to SM-33's disgust. It is also home of the trash crabs, which wear bits of scrap as shells.

at-achrann.name: At Achrann
at-achrann.bio: One of the nine hidden 'Jewels of the Old Republic', a sister world to At Attin that looks very much like it from the ground. By the New Republic Era it had fallen into war between two tribes, the Troik and the Hattan. The kids landed here thinking it was home, and Neel found it was anything but.

observatory-moon.name: Observatory Moon
observatory-moon.bio: A cold, rocky moon circling a gas giant, home to an old observatory run by the wise astronomer Kh'ymm. Jod Na Nawood brought the lost At Attin kids here in hope she could find their planet among the stars. She helped them, but quietly called in New Republic X-wings to arrest Jod, and the kids had to escape with the coordinates.

ueda.name: Ueda
ueda.bio: A remote world of green island chains linked by land bridges, a haven for wanderers of every species. Its port village, Point Ueda, has a landing pad and a little noodle shop. It is where the story of the High Republic's fall begins: a masked assassin walked into a cantina here and challenged Jedi Master Indara to a fight.

olega.name: Olega
olega.bio: A world of island chains far from Coruscant, home to Olega City and a temple of the Jedi Order in the High Republic Era. Jedi Master Torbin had taken a vow of silence and meditated here for years when the assassin Mae Aniseya came to kill him. Master Sol, Jecki, Yord and Osha confronted Mae here, but she slipped away.

carlac.name: Carlac
carlac.bio: A peaceful, sparsely populated cold world of blue-sand deserts and snowy forests, with monasteries in its north and a small colony in its south. When a Republic prison transport came down in its wilds, the crash set the Jedi and the twin sisters Osha and Mae on a collision course.

khofar.name: Khofar
khofar.bio: A wild planet of forests, jungles and deep ravines in the Outer Rim. The Wookiee Jedi Master Kelnacca lived here alone in a jungle hut. Mae came to kill him, and Master Sol and his Jedi were close behind her. In its forest, a masked dark-side warrior appeared, and in the fight that followed many Jedi lost their lives.

brendok.name: Brendok
brendok.bio: A mysterious planet in Wild Space that died during a catastrophe and somehow came back to life. A group of Jedi led by Master Indara came to find out why, and found a coven of witches led by Mother Aniseya, with twin girls, Osha and Mae, created through the Force. The night that followed destroyed the coven and set the story of The Acolyte in motion.

bal-demnic.name: Bal'demnic
bal-demnic.bio: An unexplored ocean world of vast seas and island chains, once known only by a catalogue number. It is famous for its cortosis, a rare ore that can short out a lightsaber. A former Jedi turned Sith known as the Stranger hid here, and Osha was brought to his island to be tempted by the dark side.

janix.name: Janix
janix.terrain: Jungle, mountains, a city in a crater
janix.bio: A world of jungles and mountains whose capital is a neon-lit, shadowy city of skyscrapers built inside a giant crater. It governs itself with a fragile peace between its defence force and the crime syndicates that quietly run the streets. After the Clone Wars, Maul came here to rebuild his criminal empire, just as the Empire and its Inquisitors arrived.

oba-diah.name: Oba Diah
oba-diah.bio: The homeworld of the Pykes, a world of jagged black mountains at the end of the Kessel Run. From their high fortress the Pyke Syndicate controls the spice from Kessel and sends it out across the galaxy, making them one of the most powerful crime families around and important partners, and rivals, for anyone like Maul hoping to build a criminal empire.

kenari.name: Kenari
kenari.bio: A forest world wrecked by Republic mining, where the only survivors were tribes of orphaned children living wild in the woods. Cassian Andor was born here as Kassa. When a Republic ship crashed nearby, the scavengers Maarva and Clem Andor found him and took him away to Ferrix, and Kenari was later poisoned beyond saving.

ferrix.name: Ferrix
ferrix.bio: A tough, close-knit salvage town of workshops and scrapyards, where a bell rings to start and end the working day. Cassian grew up here with Maarva and his droid B2EMO. When the Empire tightened its grip, Maarva's funeral speech, played from a hologram, turned Ferrix's quiet anger into a riot against the stormtroopers.

aldhani.name: Aldhani
aldhani.bio: A highland world where the native Dhani gather once every three years to watch a meteor shower they call the Eye. The Empire built a garrison here holding a whole sector's payroll, and a small rebel cell led by Vel Sartha, with Cassian among them, robbed it during the Eye, a heist that shook the Empire.

narkina-5.name: Narkina 5
narkina-5.bio: A water moon hiding a grim Imperial prison where inmates build machine parts in shifts on electrified floors, competing against each other for scraps. Cassian was sent here on a trumped-up charge, and with Kino Loy led a breakout across the sea. One way out!

ghorman.name: Ghorman
ghorman.bio: A proud, cultured world known for its fine silk and fashion, and for the spiders that make it. The Empire secretly wanted its minerals, so Director Krennic and the ISB stirred up trouble to justify a crackdown. The massacre in its main square made Ghorman a rallying cry and led Mon Mothma to denounce the Emperor.

mina-rau.name: Mina-Rau
mina-rau.bio: A quiet farming world of grain fields and slow seasons. Cassian and Bix tried to make a peaceful life here, working the harvest, until the Empire's new automated harvesters, and the Rebellion's needs, caught up with them.

ryloth.name: Ryloth
ryloth.bio: The homeworld of the Twi'leks, a dry, rocky planet with cities carved into cliffs. The Separatists invaded it in the Clone Wars and the Republic, with the freedom fighter Cham Syndulla, won it back. Cham's daughter Hera grew up here and became one of the Rebellion's greatest pilots.

umbara.name: Umbara
umbara.bio: A world that never sees full daylight, lit only by strange glowing plants. During the Clone Wars Captain Rex and the 501st fought a brutal campaign there under the Jedi General Pong Krell, who turned out to be a traitor sending clones to fight each other, one of the darkest stories of the war.

onderon.name: Onderon
onderon.bio: A jungle world with a great walled capital, Iziz. When a puppet king handed it to the Separatists, a group of rebels led by Steela and Saw Gerrera fought to free it, with help from Anakin, Obi-Wan and Ahsoka. Saw learned his rebel ways, and lost his sister, here.

florrum.name: Florrum
florrum.bio: A smelly desert world of sulphur pits and geysers, home base of the pirate Hondo Ohnaka and his gang. Hondo once held Count Dooku for ransom here, and later Ahsoka and a group of younglings landed in his hands.

serenno.name: Serenno
serenno.bio: A wealthy forest world, home of the aristocratic House of Dooku. Count Dooku ruled from its grand palace during the Clone Wars, and both Republic agents and bounty hunters came here to get at him.

atollon.name: Atollon
atollon.bio: A dry, out-of-the-way planet where Phoenix Squadron set up Chopper Base in Rebels, home to giant spider-like krykna and a mysterious being called the Bendu, who taught Kanan to see beyond the light and the dark. Grand Admiral Thrawn finally found the base and laid siege to it.

garel.name: Garel
garel.bio: A busy spaceport world where the rebel crew of the Ghost often met contacts and ran missions, and where the Empire ran an important cargo hub.

malachor.name: Malachor
malachor.bio: A dead world scarred by an ancient battle, holding a Sith temple that can become a superweapon. Ezra, Kanan and Ahsoka came here looking for answers, and found Maul and the Inquisitors. Here Ahsoka faced her old master, Darth Vader, and Kanan lost his sight.

ord-mantell.name: Ord Mantell
ord-mantell.bio: A rough port world full of smugglers and scrap. Clone Force 99 often came here to see Cid, a Trandoshan dealer who handed out jobs from her parlour. Han Solo famously ran into a bounty hunter here years later.

pabu.name: Pabu
pabu.bio: A peaceful island town built on a rock in the sea, a haven for refugees from the Clone Wars and the Empire. Clone Force 99 and Omega hid here for a time, and Omega finally found something like a home.

wayland.name: Wayland
wayland.bio: A misty mountain world where the Empire hid a secret cloning laboratory deep inside Mount Tantiss. Dr Hemlock held Omega and other test subjects there, and it was where the Bad Batch's final battle took place.

bracca.name: Bracca
bracca.bio: A grey junkyard world where the old warships of the Clone Wars are cut up for parts by the Scrapper Guild. The Bad Batch visited, and it was where a young Cal Kestis hid as a scrapper after Order 66.

arvala-7.name: Arvala-7
arvala-7.bio: A barren desert world where the Mandalorian found his bounty: a small green child in a floating cradle. Here he met the Ugnaught Kuiil ("I have spoken"), learned to ride a blurrg, and teamed up with IG-11 to raid the camp where the child was kept.

sorgan.name: Sorgan
sorgan.bio: A quiet forest world with villages that farm shrimp-like krill in ponds. Din Djarin came looking for somewhere to hide with Grogu, met the ex-rebel Cara Dune, and together they trained the villagers to fight off raiders and their stolen AT-ST.

trask.name: Trask
trask.bio: A wet estuary moon full of fishing boats and sea creatures. Din Djarin brought the Frog Lady and her eggs here, nearly lost Grogu to a sea monster, and met Bo-Katan Kryze and her Mandalorians, who told him about the Jedi.

corvus.name: Corvus
corvus.bio: A grey, burned forest world around the walled city of Calodan, ruled by the Imperial magistrate Morgan Elsbeth. Din Djarin took Grogu here to find Ahsoka Tano, who fought her way into the city to free its people.

concordia.name: Concordia
concordia.bio: A forest moon of Mandalore, home to the Death Watch's hideouts in its abandoned mines during the Clone Wars, and later a refuge for Mandalorians after their homeworld was ruined.

shili.name: Shili
shili.bio: The homeworld of the Togruta, a world of bright red and white grasslands. In Tales of the Jedi a baby Ahsoka Tano is shown here with her mother, and her first brush with the Force on a hunt.

raxus-secundus.name: Raxus Secundus
raxus-secundus.bio: The beautiful capital of the Separatists during the Clone Wars, where their parliament met, and a world that features in Count Dooku's turn away from the Jedi in Tales of the Jedi.

duro.name: Duro
duro.bio: The homeworld of the Duros, a blue-skinned people of starship pilots and travellers. The bounty hunter Cad Bane grew up here, and in Tales of the Underworld his past catches up with him.

muunilinst.name: Muunilinst
muunilinst.bio: The homeworld of the InterGalactic Banking Clan, run by the tall, thin Muuns. In the 2003 Clone Wars, Obi-Wan led a huge assault on it, while Anakin fought a dogfight in the skies above.

hypori.name: Hypori
hypori.bio: A barren world with a Separatist droid factory, where General Grievous made his first appearance in the 2003 Clone Wars, hunting a group of Jedi through a crashed Republic ship and showing how dangerous he was.

mon-cala.name: Mon Cala
mon-cala.bio: An ocean world, home of the Mon Calamari, who build great curved star cruisers, and the Quarren. Its people fought beneath its waves in the Clone Wars and later built the Rebel fleet's biggest ships.

nelvaan.name: Nelvaan
nelvaan.bio: A frozen world of the wolf-like Nelvaanians. In the 2003 Clone Wars, Anakin goes through a vision-filled trial in a cave here, glimpsing the dark future waiting for him, before freeing the Nelvaanians from a Separatist laboratory.

christophsis.name: Christophsis
christophsis.bio: A dazzling world where whole cities and forests are made of glittering crystal. Its battle opened the Clone Wars on screen: Anakin and Obi-Wan held off a Separatist droid army in its glassy streets, and a young Togruta Padawan named Ahsoka Tano arrived in the middle of it to meet her new master.

teth.name: Teth
teth.bio: A jungle world of towering stone mesas, one of them topped by an old monastery. Jabba's kidnapped son Rotta was hidden there, and Anakin and Ahsoka led their clones straight up the cliff walls under fire to rescue the smelly little Huttlet.

rodia.name: Rodia
rodia.bio: The steamy home of the Rodians, green-skinned hunters like Greedo. During the Clone Wars its starving people were tempted by Separatist food, until Padmé and Jar Jar exposed the trap and Nute Gunray himself was captured in Rodia's capital.

maridun.name: Maridun
maridun.bio: A quiet grassland world where the peaceful Lurmen lived in a tree village. Ahsoka and Aayla Secura sheltered a wounded Anakin there, and when the Separatists came to test a terrible new weapon on the village, the pacifist Lurmen finally chose to defend themselves.

malastare.name: Malastare
malastare.bio: Home of the Dugs and a famous podracing world. During the Clone Wars a Republic electro-proton bomb cracked its surface and woke the Zillo Beast, a giant creature that was shipped to Coruscant for study and broke loose through the capital.

vanqor.name: Vanqor
vanqor.bio: A rocky, gundark-infested world where the sabotaged Star Destroyer Endurance came down. Mace Windu, Anakin and a group of clone cadets survived the crash, and the young Boba Fett, who had caused it, slipped away with Aurra Sing.

mortis.name: Mortis
mortis.bio: A strange world inside a crystal monolith, where the Force itself takes shape as the Father, the light Daughter and the dark Son. Its seasons change in moments. Anakin was tested there as the Chosen One, and saw his own dark future before the memory was taken away.

lola-sayu.name: Lola Sayu
lola-sayu.bio: A cracked, slowly crumbling volcanic world that glows purple from orbit, home to the Citadel, an old prison built to hold rogue Jedi. The Separatists took it over, and Anakin, Obi-Wan and Ahsoka broke in to rescue Even Piell and Captain Tarkin. Piell died there, but the secret he carried got home.

trandosha.name: Trandosha
trandosha.bio: The home of the reptilian Trandoshans, a species of hunters and the old enemies of the Wookiees next door on Kashyyyk. Its moon Wasskah became the hunting ground where captured Jedi younglings, Ahsoka among them, were released as prey.

wasskah.name: Wasskah
wasskah.bio: A forested moon of Trandosha used by Garnac's hunters as a private game reserve, with captured younglings as the prey. Ahsoka organised the other prisoners to survive, and with the help of a captured Chewbacca and a Wookiee rescue party they turned the hunt around.

aleen.name: Aleen
aleen.bio: A rocky world of the small Aleena, hit by violent earthquakes during the Clone Wars. R2-D2 and C-3PO went down with the Republic's aid mission and found the cause in the caverns below, where the underground Kindalo had been disturbed.

zygerria.name: Zygerria
zygerria.bio: The home of a feline slaving empire that the Jedi had once crushed. During the Clone Wars Queen Miraj Scintel tried to revive it with Dooku's help, selling a whole colony of Togruta; Anakin, Ahsoka and Obi-Wan went undercover in her palace to free them.

kadavo.name: Kadavo
kadavo.bio: A gloomy volcanic world where the Zygerrians ran a slave processing centre perched over a fiery pit. Obi-Wan and Captain Rex were held there among the Togruta prisoners, until Anakin, Ahsoka and Plo Koon's fleet came to free them.

abafar.name: Abafar
abafar.bio: A blank, blinding world with no horizon, known as the Void, where the only thing worth taking is rhydonium fuel. Colonel Gascon and R2-D2's droid squad got lost in its whiteness hunting a Separatist encryption module.

zanbar.name: Zanbar
zanbar.bio: A swampy moon of tall rocky plateaus where Death Watch hid a camp during the Clone Wars. After Maul and Savage joined them it became a base of the Shadow Collective, and the Separatists attacked it when Dooku and Sidious came to deal with Maul.

scipio.name: Scipio
scipio.bio: The snowy headquarters of the InterGalactic Banking Clan, neutral ground where both sides of the war kept their money. Padmé's old friend Rush Clovis rose to run its banks with Palpatine's secret help, and his rule ended in a crash on Coruscant.

bardotta.name: Bardotta
bardotta.bio: A remote world of art and music, ruled by a queen who follows the advice of the mystical Dagoyan Order, who have little love for the Jedi. When its elders began to vanish, Queen Julia asked her old friend Jar Jar Binks for help, and he and Mace Windu found the Frangawl cult and Mother Talzin behind it.

moraband.name: Moraband
moraband.terrain: Red desert, tombs of Sith Lords
moraband.bio: The ancient Sith homeworld, once called Korriban: a red, wind-blasted valley of tombs and giant statues. Guided by Qui-Gon's voice, Yoda faced the spirits of the dead Sith there and resisted Darth Sidious's illusions.

anaxes.name: Anaxes
anaxes.bio: A key Republic shipyard world, fought over for most of the Clone Wars. When the Separatists started predicting every Republic move, Rex and Anakin's mission with the Bad Batch began here, and its war room led them to the captured Echo.

skako-minor.name: Skako Minor
skako-minor.bio: A cliff-covered world of the Poletec, who live high above the ground and ride the eagle-like keeradaks. The Separatists kept Echo, half-dead and wired into their computers, in a Techno Union base there until Rex and the Bad Batch broke him out.

stygeon-prime.name: Stygeon Prime
stygeon-prime.bio: A storm-blasted world home to the Spire, an Imperial prison for the Empire's most dangerous enemies. The Ghost crew broke in to rescue Jedi Master Luminara Unduli, only to find she was already dead and her image used as bait by the Grand Inquisitor.

seelos.name: Seelos
seelos.bio: A blinding white salt desert where Captain Rex, Wolffe and Gregor were living out their old age in a refitted AT-TE, hunting giant joopa worms. The Ghost crew found them there, and Rex rejoined the fight against the Empire.

concord-dawn.name: Concord Dawn
concord-dawn.bio: An old Mandalorian farming world, home of the Journeyman Protectors who once kept the peace there. Under the Empire its Protectors, led by Fenn Rau, guarded the hyperspace lanes and shot down rebel ships, until Sabine and Kanan won Rau to their side.

lira-san.name: Lira San
lira-san.bio: The legendary homeworld of the Lasat, hidden at the centre of a star cluster and found only by following an ancient prophecy. Zeb and the last Lasat survivors found it, and after the war Zeb settled there among his own people at last.

krownest.name: Krownest
krownest.bio: A cold, wild world where Sabine Wren's family, Clan Wren, lived in their fortress after leaving Mandalore. Sabine came home there with the Darksaber, and her mother Ursa had to choose between the Empire and her daughter.

mykapo.name: Mykapo
mykapo.bio: A small Outer Rim world whose teenage resistance fighters, the Iron Squadron, held out against the Empire in an old Republic corvette. The Ghost crew helped them escape Thrawn's blockade and join the Rebellion.

chandrila.name: Chandrila
chandrila.bio: A peaceful, green Core World known for its democracy, home of Mon Mothma. Her daughter Leida's lavish wedding there was the cover for dangerous meetings, as Mon worked to keep her funding of the Rebellion hidden from the Empire.

dantooine.name: Dantooine
dantooine.bio: A quiet, grassy world on the edge of the galaxy. In the Clone Wars Mace Windu fought a droid army there with his bare hands, and later the Rebellion hid a base on Dantooine; Leia named it to Tarkin, knowing it had already been abandoned.

millennium-falcon.name: Millennium Falcon
millennium-falcon.bio: The fastest hunk of junk in the galaxy. Lando Calrissian lost her to Han Solo in a game of sabacc, and Han and Chewbacca turned the battered freighter into a legend: the Kessel Run in under twelve parsecs, the rescue of Princess Leia, the attack on the second Death Star. Decades later a young scavenger named Rey found her sitting under a tarp on Jakku.

tantive-iv.name: Tantive IV
tantive-iv.bio: Bail Organa's diplomatic ship, which carried baby Leia home to Alderaan. Years later, with the stolen Death Star plans aboard, it was chased down by Darth Vader's Star Destroyer above Tatooine, just after Leia hid the plans and a message inside R2-D2. Leia used it again in her final years as general of the Resistance.

ds-1-orbital-battle-station.name: Death Star
ds-1-orbital-battle-station.maker: Imperial Military Department of Military Research
ds-1-orbital-battle-station.bio: The Empire's ultimate weapon, a moon-sized battle station with a superlaser that can destroy a planet. Built in secret over twenty years, partly from Galen Erso's designs, it destroyed Jedha City, Scarif and Alderaan. Galen had hidden a fatal flaw inside it: a small exhaust port leading to the reactor, which Luke Skywalker hit with a pair of proton torpedoes.

ds-2-death-star-ii-mobile-battle-station.name: Death Star II
ds-2-death-star-ii-mobile-battle-station.maker: Imperial Military Department of Military Research
ds-2-death-star-ii-mobile-battle-station.bio: A bigger second Death Star, built above the forest moon of Endor and deliberately left half-finished as bait. The Emperor let the Rebels learn its location and waited for them with a fully working superlaser. It was destroyed when Lando Calrissian and Wedge Antilles flew into its core, while inside, Darth Vader turned on the Emperor.

t-65b-x-wing-starfighter.name: X-wing
t-65b-x-wing-starfighter.bio: The Rebel Alliance's workhorse fighter, with four wings that split into an X for combat and a droid socket for an astromech like R2-D2. Luke Skywalker flew one as Red Five to destroy the first Death Star, crash-landed one in Dagobah's swamp, and watched Yoda lift it out with the Force.

t-65-x-wing-starfighter.name: X-wing
t-65-x-wing-starfighter.bio: The classic X-wing, the fighter that won the Galactic Civil War and became the backbone of the New Republic's patrols. Pilots like Wedge Antilles and Luke Skywalker made it famous, and years later its sight still means help is coming, or trouble, for anyone hiding from the law.

btl-y-wing-starfighter.name: Y-wing
btl-y-wing-starfighter.bio: A tough, slow fighter-bomber first built for the Republic during the Clone Wars. By the time of the Rebellion many were old and patched together, but they still carried heavy bombs. Gold Squadron flew Y-wings in the Death Star trench run, and Y-wings attacked the shield gate at Scarif.

tie-ln-space-superiority-starfighter.name: TIE fighter
tie-ln-space-superiority-starfighter.bio: The Empire's standard fighter, recognisable by its screaming twin ion engines and big hexagonal wings. Cheap and built in huge numbers, it has no shields and no hyperdrive, and its pilots are expected to win through sheer numbers. Its scream is one of the most famous sounds in the galaxy.

tie-advanced-x1.name: TIE Advanced x1
tie-advanced-x1.bio: Darth Vader's personal fighter, an improved TIE with bent wings, shields and a hyperdrive. Vader flew it in the Death Star trench, picking off Rebel pilots one by one and almost catching Luke, until Han Solo came back in the Falcon and sent him spinning off into space.

imperial-i-class-star-destroyer.name: Star Destroyer
imperial-i-class-star-destroyer.bio: The dagger-shaped symbol of Imperial power, bristling with guns and carrying TIE fighters, walkers and thousands of troops. The sight of one sliding overhead was enough to make whole systems surrender. The first shot of Star Wars is one of these chasing Tantive IV.

sandcrawler.name: Sandcrawler
sandcrawler.bio: Huge rusting treaded vehicles left behind on Tatooine from an old mining operation, now used as rolling homes and workshops by the Jawas. They wander the deserts collecting scrap and stray droids to sell. One of them picked up R2-D2 and C-3PO and sold them to Owen Lars.

executor.name: Executor
executor.bio: Darth Vader's flagship, a Super Star Destroyer many times the size of a normal Star Destroyer. Vader used it to lead the hunt for the Rebels after Hoth and to chase the Millennium Falcon. At the Battle of Endor an A-wing crashed into its bridge and the giant ship plunged into the second Death Star.

all-terrain-armored-transport.name: AT-AT walker
all-terrain-armored-transport.bio: The Empire's giant four-legged walkers, heavily armoured and almost impossible to stop with blaster fire. At the Battle of Hoth they marched across the snow towards Echo Base. The Rebels' snowspeeders learned to trip them with harpoons and tow cables, and Luke brought one down with a grenade from underneath.

t-47-airspeeder.name: Snowspeeder
t-47-airspeeder.bio: Small two-seat airspeeders the Rebels adapted to fly in Hoth's freezing cold. With a pilot in front and a gunner facing backwards working the tow cable, they took on the Imperial walkers. Wedge Antilles and his gunner tripped the first AT-AT by wrapping a cable round its legs.

slave-i.name: Slave I
slave-i.bio: The ship of the bounty hunters Jango Fett and then his son Boba. It flies standing upright and lands lying flat, and it is full of hidden weapons, including seismic charges. Boba Fett used it to follow the Millennium Falcon to Cloud City and carried the frozen Han Solo away to Jabba.

all-terrain-scout-transport.name: AT-ST walker
all-terrain-scout-transport.bio: A lighter two-legged walker used by the Empire for patrols and support. On Endor they guarded the shield generator and stomped through the forest after the Rebels, until the Ewoks dropped logs and boulders on them and Chewbacca took one over.

tydirium.name: Tydirium
tydirium.bio: A stolen Imperial shuttle that the Rebel strike team used to slip down to the forest moon of Endor. Its old clearance code got them past the Imperial fleet, even though Darth Vader sensed Luke aboard and let them through anyway.

74-z-speeder-bike.name: Speeder bike
74-z-speeder-bike.bio: Fast, light hover bikes used by Imperial scout troopers. On Endor, Luke and Leia stole two of them and raced scouts through the giant trees at deadly speed, in one of the most famous chases in the saga.

home-one.name: Home One
home-one.bio: The Rebel Alliance's command ship, a curved Mon Calamari star cruiser. Admiral Ackbar led the attack on the second Death Star from its bridge, and it was there that he realised the Rebels had flown into a trap.

rz-1-a-wing-interceptor.name: A-wing
rz-1-a-wing-interceptor.bio: A tiny, very fast interceptor with little armour, flown by the Rebellion's most daring pilots. At the Battle of Endor an A-wing crashed into the bridge of the Executor, bringing down Darth Vader's Super Star Destroyer.

a-sf-01-b-wing-starfighter.name: B-wing
a-sf-01-b-wing-starfighter.bio: An odd-looking but powerful heavy fighter, a long rotating wing with the cockpit at one end, built to attack big capital ships. B-wings joined the Rebel fleet at the Battle of Endor, and Rebels in Phoenix Squadron helped bring the first ones to the Alliance.

khetanna.name: Khetanna
khetanna.bio: Jabba the Hutt's luxury sail barge, which carried him and his court out to the Great Pit of Carkoon to feed Luke, Han and Chewbacca to the Sarlacc. Luke had a lightsaber hidden in R2-D2, and the barge ended up in flames after Leia strangled Jabba with her chain.

j-type-327-nubian-royal-starship.name: Naboo royal starship
j-type-327-nubian-royal-starship.maker: Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps
j-type-327-nubian-royal-starship.bio: Queen Amidala's gleaming chrome ship, built to carry the queen in style. It broke through the Trade Federation blockade of Naboo with its hyperdrive damaged, forcing a landing on Tatooine, where the Jedi met a young slave named Anakin Skywalker. R2-D2 saved it during the escape by fixing its shields.

n-1-starfighter.name: Naboo N-1 starfighter
n-1-starfighter.maker: Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps
n-1-starfighter.bio: Elegant yellow and chrome fighters flown by the Royal Naboo Security Forces. Young Anakin hid in one during the Battle of Naboo, took off by accident, flew into the droid control ship and blew it up from the inside, shutting down the whole droid army.

anakin-skywalker-s-podracer.name: Anakin's podracer
anakin-skywalker-s-podracer.bio: The podracer nine-year-old Anakin Skywalker built himself from scrap, two huge engines pulling a tiny cockpit. He raced it in the Boonta Eve Classic on Tatooine against the cheating champion Sebulba, and won, which freed him from slavery and let him leave with the Jedi.

scimitar.name: Scimitar
scimitar.bio: Darth Maul's personal ship, sleek and dark, with a cloaking device. Maul flew it to Tatooine to hunt down Queen Amidala and the Jedi, and landed it there before his first clash with Qui-Gon Jinn in the desert.

lucrehulk-class-droid-control-ship.name: Droid control ship
lucrehulk-class-droid-control-ship.bio: A huge ring-shaped Trade Federation ship that sent signals controlling the entire droid army on Naboo. When young Anakin blew up its reactor from inside, every battle droid on the planet shut down at once.

radiant-vii.name: Radiant VII
radiant-vii.bio: The red diplomatic cruiser that carried Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi to the Trade Federation blockade of Naboo, flying the colours of a ship of peace. The Trade Federation shot it down as soon as the Jedi were aboard their flagship.

delta-7-aethersprite-class-light-interce.name: Jedi starfighter
delta-7-aethersprite-class-light-interce.bio: A small wedge-shaped fighter used by the Jedi at the start of the Clone Wars, too small for a hyperdrive, so it docks with a ring to jump. Obi-Wan flew one to Kamino and Geonosis and dodged Jango Fett's seismic charges in an asteroid field.

low-altitude-assault-transport-infantry.name: Republic gunship
low-altitude-assault-transport-infantry.bio: The clone army's gunship, carrying troops and walkers into battle with heavy guns on every side. Gunships swooped into the Geonosis arena to rescue the trapped Jedi in the first battle of the Clone Wars, and flew in almost every battle after.

acclamator-i-class-assault-ship.name: Acclamator assault ship
acclamator-i-class-assault-ship.bio: The first big warships of the Republic's new clone army, carrying troops, walkers and gunships. At the end of Attack of the Clones rows of them lift off from Coruscant, carrying clone troopers to war.

punworcca-116-class-interstellar-sloop.name: Dooku's solar sailer
punworcca-116-class-interstellar-sloop.bio: Count Dooku's elegant Geonosian ship, pulled through space by a huge sail. Dooku escaped Geonosis in it after defeating Anakin and Obi-Wan and dueling Yoda, and flew it to Coruscant to report to his master, Darth Sidious.

j-type-star-skiff.name: Naboo star skiff
j-type-star-skiff.maker: Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps
j-type-star-skiff.bio: Senator Padmé Amidala's sleek chrome ship. She and Anakin flew it from Naboo to Tatooine and then on to Geonosis to rescue Obi-Wan, where they were captured themselves.

invisible-hand.name: Invisible Hand
invisible-hand.bio: General Grievous's flagship. During the Battle of Coruscant, Anakin and Obi-Wan fought their way aboard to rescue Chancellor Palpatine, and Anakin killed Count Dooku there. The burning ship broke in half and Anakin crash-landed what was left of it on Coruscant.

venator-class-star-destroyer.name: Venator Star Destroyer
venator-class-star-destroyer.bio: The Republic's main warship during the Clone Wars, a carrier for hundreds of fighters with a red hull and twin towers. Hundreds of them clashed with the Separatist fleet in the skies over Coruscant at the start of Revenge of the Sith.

arc-170-starfighter.name: ARC-170
arc-170-starfighter.bio: A big three-seat clone fighter with wings that open in combat. Clone pilots flew them alongside Anakin and Obi-Wan above Coruscant, and Commander Cody's pilots used them to shoot down Jedi Master Plo Koon when Order 66 came through.

eta-2-actis-class-light-interceptor.name: Jedi interceptor
eta-2-actis-class-light-interceptor.bio: The tiny, agile fighters flown by the Jedi in the last months of the Clone Wars, with wings that open in combat. Anakin and Obi-Wan led the charge to rescue the Chancellor in a pair of them, with buzz droids chewing at Obi-Wan's ship.

theta-class-t-2c-shuttle.name: Theta-class shuttle
theta-class-t-2c-shuttle.bio: A shuttle with three fold-up wings, forerunner of the Empire's famous Lambda shuttles. Darth Sidious flew to Mustafar in one to find his new apprentice burning, and brought Darth Vader back to Coruscant.

hex-kom-rk-class.name: Hex
hex-kom-rk-class.bio: A Mandalorian Kom'rk-class fighter-transport, the kind flown by Mandalore's warriors and their allies, seen during Maul's attempt to rebuild his criminal empire on Janix after the Clone Wars.

lambda-class-t-4a-shuttle.name: Imperial shuttle
lambda-class-t-4a-shuttle.bio: The Empire's classic three-winged shuttle, used to ferry officers and Imperial dignitaries from ship to ship. Darth Vader and the Emperor both travelled in them, and the folding wings make them one of the most recognisable shapes in the galaxy.

scythe-phi-class.name: The Scythe
scythe-phi-class.bio: The Inquisitors' ship, a sharp grey shuttle used by the hunters of the last Jedi. Reva and her fellow Inquisitors used it to chase Obi-Wan and young Leia across the galaxy.

sw-0608.name: Rogue One
sw-0608.bio: A stolen Imperial cargo shuttle that carried Jyn Erso's team to Scarif. Bodhi Rook gave it the call sign 'Rogue One' as it slipped past the shield gate, and the name stuck to the whole unauthorised mission.

ut-60d-u-wing-starfighter-support-craft.name: U-wing
ut-60d-u-wing-starfighter-support-craft.bio: A Rebel troop carrier and gunship. Cassian Andor and K-2SO flew Jyn Erso in one to Jedha and Eadu, and U-wings dropped Rebel soldiers onto the beaches of Scarif.

profundity.name: Profundity
profundity.bio: Admiral Raddus's flagship, which led the Rebel fleet to Scarif when he heard Rogue One had gone in alone. It received the Death Star plans, then was captured by Darth Vader, who slaughtered its crew in a dark corridor as the plans slipped away to the Tantive IV.

lightmaker.name: Lightmaker
lightmaker.bio: A small Rebel corvette with a hammer-shaped bow. At Scarif its crew rammed a disabled Star Destroyer into a second one, pushing both into the shield gate and destroying it, so the Death Star plans could be sent out.

all-terrain-armored-cargo-transport.name: AT-ACT walker
all-terrain-armored-cargo-transport.bio: Huge cargo-carrying walkers used on Scarif and in Jedha's mines. During the Battle of Scarif they lumbered along the beaches firing on the Rebel troops in the palm groves.

20-t-railcrawler-conveyex-transport.name: Conveyex
20-t-railcrawler-conveyex-transport.bio: An Imperial armoured train winding around the mountains of Vandor, carrying the hugely valuable fuel coaxium. Beckett's crew tried to steal a carriage of it while hanging off the side, until Enfys Nest's raiders arrived and the heist went badly wrong.

first-light.name: First Light
first-light.bio: The luxury yacht of Dryden Vos, a crime lord of the Crimson Dawn syndicate, full of art and dangerous guests. It is where Han meets Qi'ra again after years apart, and where the story's betrayals come to a head.

all-terrain-heavy-hauler.name: AT-hauler
all-terrain-heavy-hauler.bio: An Imperial cargo lifter with long gripping arms. Beckett's crew used one to try to snatch a carriage of coaxium from the conveyex on Vandor.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.bio: Hera Syndulla's ship, home of the rebel crew of Rebels and part of the Rebellion for years. Hera flies it again in Ahsoka, with her son Jacen aboard, and it can be spotted in Rogue One and The Rise of Skywalker.

eye-of-sion.name: Eye of Sion
eye-of-sion.bio: A great old ship carrying Morgan Elsbeth, Baylan Skoll and Shin Hati, launched through the hyperspace ring on Seatos to another galaxy. It landed on Peridea, where the Nightsisters had been waiting to bring back Grand Admiral Thrawn.

baylan-s-shuttle.name: Baylan's shuttle
baylan-s-shuttle.bio: The shuttle of the former Jedi Baylan Skoll and his apprentice Shin Hati, mercenaries hired by Morgan Elsbeth to find the map to Thrawn.

chimaera.name: Chimaera
chimaera.bio: Grand Admiral Thrawn's flagship, last seen being dragged into hyperspace by space whales at the Liberation of Lothal. It survived, stranded with Thrawn in another galaxy, and in Ahsoka he finally brings it home.

finalizer.name: Finalizer
finalizer.bio: Kylo Ren's First Order command ship, a giant new Star Destroyer. It led the raid on Tuanul village on Jakku, and it is where Finn and Poe escaped in a stolen TIE fighter.

black-one.name: Black One
black-one.bio: Poe Dameron's black X-wing, the best ship in the Resistance flown by its best pilot. Poe led the raid on Starkiller Base in it, and took out a First Order dreadnought's defences single-handed before it was destroyed in the attack on D'Qar.

upsilon-class-command-shuttle.name: Kylo Ren's shuttle
upsilon-class-command-shuttle.bio: A tall black shuttle with huge folding wings, carrying Kylo Ren on First Order business, like his arrival in the village of Tuanul on Jakku where he looked for the map to Luke Skywalker.

tie-fo-space-superiority-fighter.name: First Order TIE fighter
tie-fo-space-superiority-fighter.bio: The First Order's updated TIE fighter, sleeker and better armed than the old Imperial ones. Finn and Poe stole a two-seat version to escape from the Finalizer, and crashed it on Jakku.

eravana.name: Eravana
eravana.bio: Han Solo's huge freighter during his smuggling days after the war. It caught the Millennium Falcon with Rey and Finn aboard, and was the place where Han carried a cargo of very dangerous rathtars.

raddus.name: Raddus
raddus.bio: The Resistance's flagship, named after the admiral who died at Scarif. It led the long chase after D'Qar, and Vice Admiral Holdo turned it around and jumped to lightspeed straight through Snoke's flagship, cutting it in half.

supremacy.name: Supremacy
supremacy.bio: Supreme Leader Snoke's enormous flying-wing flagship, a mobile capital for the First Order. In its throne room Kylo Ren killed Snoke and fought his guards beside Rey, before Holdo rammed the Raddus through the ship at lightspeed.

v-4x-d-ski-speeder.name: Ski speeder
v-4x-d-ski-speeder.bio: Battered old speeders the Resistance found in the Rebel base on Crait, with a keel that scrapes the ground. Racing across the salt flats they kicked up the red crystal dust underneath, and Finn nearly flew one into the First Order's battering-ram cannon.

mg-100-starfortress-sf-17.name: Resistance bomber
mg-100-starfortress-sf-17.bio: Slow, heavy bombers carrying racks of bombs in their bellies. At D'Qar the bombers attacked a First Order dreadnought and destroyed it, but every one of them was lost. Rose Tico's sister Paige dropped the bombs that finished it off.

tie-vn-space-superiority-fighter.name: TIE silencer
tie-vn-space-superiority-fighter.bio: Kylo Ren's personal fighter in The Last Jedi, long and arrow-shaped. He used it to attack the Raddus, but hesitated when he sensed his mother aboard.

steadfast-resurgent-class.name: Steadfast
steadfast-resurgent-class.bio: The First Order's flagship in The Rise of Skywalker, where Allegiant General Pryde ran the fleet and General Hux turned out to be a spy for the Resistance. Chewbacca was held prisoner aboard, and Rey and her friends slipped onto it to rescue him.

xyston-class-star-destroyer.name: Sith Star Destroyer
xyston-class-star-destroyer.bio: The thousands of red-marked Star Destroyers built in secret on Exegol for the Final Order, each armed with a superlaser able to destroy a planet. One showed its power by destroying Kijimi, before ordinary people across the galaxy flew to Exegol to stop the fleet.

kylo-ren-s-tie-whisper.name: TIE whisper
kylo-ren-s-tie-whisper.bio: Kylo Ren's fighter in The Rise of Skywalker, with wings swept forward. He flew it across the desert of Pasaana towards Rey, who flipped over it with a single slash of her lightsaber.

din-djarin-s-n-1-starfighter.name: Din Djarin's N-1
din-djarin-s-n-1-starfighter.maker: Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps
din-djarin-s-n-1-starfighter.bio: An old Naboo starfighter rebuilt by Peli Motto for Din Djarin after his Razor Crest was destroyed, with a hot-rodded engine and a seat for Grogu. It is now the Mandalorian's ship.

guillotine-starship.name: Guillotine
guillotine-starship.bio: A heavily modified fighter that Din Djarin and Grogu run into on their travels during The Mandalorian and Grogu.

carson-teva-s-x-wing.name: Carson Teva's X-wing
carson-teva-s-x-wing.bio: The X-wing of Captain Carson Teva, a New Republic pilot of the Adelphi Rangers, who keeps watch on the Outer Rim and works with Din Djarin.

onyx-cinder.name: Onyx Cinder
onyx-cinder.bio: An old pirate ship found buried in the woods of At Attin by Wim and his friends. When they accidentally flew it out into space with the droid pirate SM-33 aboard, it carried them across the galaxy, pirates in pursuit, looking for the way back home.

silvo-s-pirate-frigate.name: Pirate frigate
silvo-s-pirate-frigate.bio: The pirate ship once commanded by Captain Silvo and taken over by Brutus, which hunted the Onyx Cinder and the kids, hoping to follow them to the hidden treasure planet of At Attin.

polan-gx-8.name: Jedi transport
polan-gx-8.bio: The white and gold transport ships of the Jedi in the High Republic era, carrying Master Sol and his team from planet to planet on the trail of the assassin Mae.

jedi-vector.name: Jedi Vector
jedi-vector.bio: A sleek starfighter designed for the Jedi of the High Republic, built to work with a Jedi's reflexes, flown by Jedi on missions of their own.

dte-csa-17-calaboose-prison-ship.name: Prison ship
dte-csa-17-calaboose-prison-ship.bio: A Republic prison transport of the High Republic era. One of them came down on Carlac, setting off a hunt through the planet's snowy wilds.

twilight.name: Twilight
twilight.bio: A battered freighter Anakin and Ahsoka grabbed from a Hutt hangar on Teth while escaping with Jabba's son. Anakin kept it, patched it and flew it all through the war, its long folding wing and wobbly engines easy to spot. Obi-Wan finally lost it in the snows of Mandalore.

malevolence.name: Malevolence
malevolence.bio: General Grievous's secret flagship, almost five kilometres long, with twin ion cannons that could knock out a whole Republic fleet in one shot. Plo Koon survived its first attack; Anakin, Ahsoka and Obi-Wan later rescued Padmé from inside it and steered it into a dead moon.

munificent-class-star-frigate.name: Munificent-class Frigate
munificent-class-star-frigate.bio: The Banking Clan's long, spine-shaped warship, built to collect debts by force and then turned into a mainstay of the Separatist fleet. Its huge forward cannons could hit a planet from orbit, and squadrons of them guarded the blockades of Christophsis and Ryloth.

v-19-torrent-starfighter.name: V-19 Torrent
v-19-torrent-starfighter.bio: An early-war Republic fighter with folding wings that gave it a gull-like look. Clone pilots flew it at Christophsis, against the Malevolence and over Ryloth before the Z-95 Headhunter and the ARC-170 took over its jobs.

all-terrain-tactical-enforcer.name: AT-TE
all-terrain-tactical-enforcer.bio: The Republic's six-legged tank, which droids nicknamed "six legs". Slow but nearly unstoppable, it could carry a squad inside, climb cliffs with magnetic feet and fire a heavy mass-driver cannon from its back. AT-TEs marched on Geonosis, Christophsis and Anaxes.

barc-speeder.name: BARC Speeder
barc-speeder.bio: A long, heavy speeder bike used by clone scouts and commandos, with blasters in the nose and room for a gunner pod. Clones raced them across Geonosis and Saleucami, and the Empire's later speeder bikes were built from the same idea.

coronet.name: Coronet
coronet.bio: Duchess Satine's graceful liner, a symbol of peaceful Mandalore. On her voyage to the Senate it became a trap: assassin droids crawled through the hull and a traitor senator tried to poison her, while Obi-Wan and Anakin hunted the killers through its decks.

endurance.name: Endurance
endurance.bio: Admiral Kilian's Star Destroyer, sabotaged by a disguised young Boba Fett who wanted Mace Windu dead. Its crippled hull crashed on Vanqor, where Mace and Anakin crawled out of the wreck and Boba made his escape with Aurra Sing.

xanadu-blood.name: Xanadu Blood
xanadu-blood.bio: Cad Bane's sleek, dagger-shaped ship, given to him by Darth Sidious as part of the payment for stealing a Jedi holocron. Bane flew it from heist to heist, kidnapping Force-sensitive children for the Sith and slipping away from the Jedi again and again.

providence-class-dreadnought.name: Separatist Dreadnought
providence-class-dreadnought.bio: The Separatist answer to the Venator: a big carrier-destroyer packed with droid fighters, landing craft and heavy guns. Grievous's own Invisible Hand was one, and these warships led the fleets above Mon Cala, Umbara and Ryloth.

trident-class-assault-ship.name: Trident Assault Ship
trident-class-assault-ship.bio: A squid-shaped Separatist warship that flew through space and swam through oceans, its long tentacles grabbing submarines. Tridents spearheaded the Quarren and Separatist attack on the underwater cities of Mon Cala.

eta-class-shuttle.name: Eta-class Shuttle
eta-class-shuttle.bio: A boxy Republic shuttle used by senators and Jedi envoys. Anakin, Obi-Wan and Ahsoka used one for the daring landing on Lola Sayu to break Even Piell out of the Citadel prison.

crucible.name: Crucible
crucible.bio: An ancient Jedi ship that carried younglings to Ilum for the Gathering, where they found the crystals for their first lightsabers. Its teacher, the droid professor Huyang, had flown it for centuries; on Ahsoka's trip, Hondo Ohnaka's pirates tried to steal it.

clone-z-95-starfighter.name: Z-95 Headhunter
clone-z-95-starfighter.bio: A tough little Republic fighter flown by clone pilots in the later Clone Wars, the ancestor of the X-wing. Headhunters flew in Plo Koon's Wolfpack, over Umbara and Ringo Vinda, and in Ahsoka's final mission to Mandalore.

gozanti-class-cruiser.name: Gozanti-class Cruiser
gozanti-class-cruiser.bio: A rugged, stubby transport that turned up everywhere: as a Hutt and pirate freighter in the Clone Wars, as Black Sun and Separatist ships, and later as the Empire's TIE fighter carrier. Smugglers, slavers and Imperials all trusted it to haul anything.

all-terrain-reconnaissance-transport.name: AT-RT
all-terrain-reconnaissance-transport.bio: An open, two-legged walker ridden by a single clone scout, with a blaster cannon in front. AT-RTs ran through the dark jungles of Umbara and the streets of Onderon, the ancestors of the Empire's scout walkers.

btl-b-y-wing-starfighter-bomber.name: BTL-B Y-wing
btl-b-y-wing-starfighter-bomber.bio: The first Y-wings, built for the Republic in the Clone Wars with smooth armour plating and a gunner behind the pilot. Anakin's Shadow Squadron flew them against the Malevolence, and the same tough design was still flying for the Rebellion decades later.

kom-rk-class-fighter-transport.name: Mandalorian Gauntlet
kom-rk-class-fighter-transport.bio: Death Watch's big Mandalorian fighter, whose wings fold up around the hull for landing. Pre Vizsla's warriors and later Maul's Shadow Collective flew them; decades later Bo-Katan Kryze led the Nite Owls in one of her own.

taylander-shuttle.name: Taylander Shuttle
taylander-shuttle.bio: An ordinary civilian shuttle found all over the galaxy, which made it perfect for slipping through unnoticed. In the last year of the Clone Wars it carried senators and Banking Clan agents, and later the early rebels flew them on undercover missions.

hh-87-starhopper.name: HH-87 Starhopper
hh-87-starhopper.bio: A fast, long-range fighter long used by the Hutt Clans and the criminals who worked for them. In the Clone Wars bounty hunters and Hutt patrols flew the curved little ship through the underworld.

marauder-omicron-class.name: Havoc Marauder
marauder-omicron-class.bio: Clone Force 99's ship and, as Omega said, their home. Tech modified it to fly missions no ordinary clone ship could, and after the Empire took over it carried the Bad Batch to Ord Mantell, Pabu and back to Kamino until it was lost in a crash.

phantom.name: Phantom
phantom.bio: The Ghost's little attack shuttle, docked in the back of the freighter and used for raids, rescues and getaways. Ezra, Sabine and Zeb flew it all over Lothal until it was lost at Reklam Station; Hera later named its replacement the Phantom II.

sentinel-class-landing-craft.name: Sentinel Landing Craft
sentinel-class-landing-craft.bio: A heavy Imperial troop transport with folding wings, used by Agent Kallus and the Grand Inquisitor to drop stormtroopers onto Lothal. Its arrival usually meant the Ghost crew had to run, fast.

all-terrain-defense-pod.name: AT-DP
all-terrain-defense-pod.bio: The Empire's two-legged patrol walker, the backbone of small garrisons like Lothal's. Each carried a driver and a gunner and kept the farmers and street kids in line; the rebels became experts at tripping them up.

phantom-ii.name: Phantom II
phantom-ii.bio: An old Separatist shuttle the Spectres found on Agamar and rebuilt to replace their lost Phantom. It docked in the back of the Ghost and flew Ezra, Sabine and Kanan on countless missions in the last years before the Rebellion went to war.

arquitens-class-command-cruiser.name: Imperial Light Cruiser
arquitens-class-command-cruiser.bio: A small Imperial warship used to patrol trade routes and blockade worlds. Commander Sato's rebels and the Ghost crew fought them over Lothal and Ibaar, and Agent Kallus and Admiral Konstantine used them to hunt the fleet.

sphyrna-class-hammerhead-corvette.name: Hammerhead Corvette
sphyrna-class-hammerhead-corvette.bio: An old armed transport with a flat, hammer-shaped bow. Commander Sato's Phoenix Squadron flew them as warships, and years later the Rebellion used one to push the disabled Star Destroyer into the shield gate at Scarif.

blade-wing.name: Blade Wing
blade-wing.bio: The first B-wing, built in secret by the Mon Calamari engineer Quarrie on the planet Shantipole. Hera tamed its tricky gyroscopic cockpit and flew it to break the Imperial blockade of Ibaar, proving the design that would one day fight at Endor.

tie-d-defender-multi-role-starfighter.name: TIE Defender
tie-d-defender-multi-role-starfighter.bio: Grand Admiral Thrawn's pet project: a three-winged TIE with shields and a hyperdrive, far deadlier than a standard fighter. The rebels raided the Lothal factory building it, Ezra and Sabine stole the Defender Elite prototype, and the liberation of Lothal ended the programme.

614-ava-speeder-bike.name: Lothal Speeder Bike
614-ava-speeder-bike.bio: The Empire's patrol bike on Lothal, ridden by scout troopers through Capital City and across the grasslands. Ezra and his friends stole them so often that they became as much rebel transport as Imperial.

luthen-rael-s-fondor-haulcraft.name: The Fondor
luthen-rael-s-fondor-haulcraft.bio: Luthen Rael's harmless-looking courier ship, hiding blades of laser light, a tractor-beam trick and a droid copilot. Luthen used it to slip past Imperial patrols, and its sudden escape from a Star Destroyer showed Cassian how far the antiques dealer would go.

tie-avenger-prototype.name: TIE Avenger
tie-avenger-prototype.bio: A secret Imperial fighter with folding wings and a hyperdrive, tested in Sienar's yards. Cassian Andor stole one in a daring escape a year after Narkina 5, then flew it to Yavin 4, where the squabbling rebel factions nearly shot him down.

alpha-3-nimbus-class-v-wing-starfighter.name: V-wing
alpha-3-nimbus-class-v-wing-starfighter.bio: A small, nimble fighter with tall folding wings, flown by clone pilots at the end of the Clone Wars and by the early Imperial Navy after it. Crosshair's Imperial units and the patrols that hunted the Bad Batch flew them.

rho-class-transport-shuttle.name: Rho-class Shuttle
rho-class-transport-shuttle.bio: A big military shuttle with folding wings, used by the Republic and then the Empire to move troops and prisoners. The Bad Batch saw them carry clones off Kamino and children to Mount Tantiss.

razor-crest.name: Razor Crest
razor-crest.bio: Din Djarin's battered old patrol ship and home, with carbonite storage in the hold and a sleeping cubby where Grogu played with the controls. Repaired again and again, it carried them across the Outer Rim until Moff Gideon's cruiser blasted it to pieces on Tython.

gideon-s-light-cruiser.name: Moff Gideon's Cruiser
gideon-s-light-cruiser.bio: The Imperial warship from which Moff Gideon hunted Grogu. Din Djarin, Bo-Katan, Cara and Fennec stormed it to rescue the child, and when the dark troopers closed in, a lone X-wing landed and Luke Skywalker cut his way down the corridor.

bo-katan-kryze-s-gauntlet-starfighter.name: Bo-Katan's Gauntlet
bo-katan-kryze-s-gauntlet-starfighter.bio: Bo-Katan Kryze's Mandalorian fighter, flown by her Nite Owls as they hunted for the Darksaber and the people to free Mandalore. She raided Imperial ships with it, sat alone in it at her ruined castle, and led the fleet home from it.

t-6-shuttle.name: T-6 Shuttle
t-6-shuttle.bio: An elegant Jedi transport whose spinning ring of wings kept the cockpit level. Old and slow by the Clone Wars, it still carried Jedi on diplomatic missions, and Dooku and Qui-Gon used one; its cockpit design later turned up in the B-wing.

undicur-class-jumpspeeder.name: Jedi Jumpspeeder
undicur-class-jumpspeeder.bio: A light speeder bike favoured by Jedi on solo missions. After Order 66 survivors like the young Jedi Lyco Strata still rode them, and Asajj Ventress's journey with Lyco across the empty worlds of the Outer Rim began on one.

flitknot-speeder-bike.name: Flitknot Speeder
