flitknot-speeder-bike.bio: A light, insect-like Geonosian speeder used by the Separatists; Count Dooku fled the arena battle on Geonosis on one. After the war such bikes ended up with drifters and bounty hunters all over the Outer Rim.

ginivex-class-starfighter.name: Ventress's Fanblade
ginivex-class-starfighter.bio: Asajj Ventress's personal fighter, whose huge fan of wings could open like a sail and close for speed. Built by Geonosian shipwrights, it carried Count Dooku's assassin from one Clone Wars battlefield to the next.

luke-skywalker.name: Luke Skywalker
luke-skywalker.bio: A farm boy from Tatooine who dreamed of flying, until two droids and an old hermit pulled him into the Rebellion. He destroyed the first Death Star, trained with Yoda, learned that Darth Vader was his father, and refused to give up on him. Decades later, broken by his failure with Ben Solo, he hid on Ahch-To until Rey came for him.

leia-skywalker-organa-solo.name: Leia Organa
leia-skywalker-organa-solo.bio: Princess of Alderaan, senator, and a leader of the Rebellion from her teens. Captured with the Death Star plans, she watched her planet destroyed and never broke. She was Luke's twin sister, married Han Solo, and, after the New Republic failed to listen, founded the Resistance and led it as General Organa.

han-solo.name: Han Solo
han-solo.bio: A Corellian street kid turned smuggler, captain of the Millennium Falcon with his best friend Chewbacca. He only meant to deliver a couple of passengers to Alderaan, but came back to save Luke at the Death Star, fell for Leia, and was frozen in carbonite. Years later he faced his own son, Kylo Ren, on Starkiller Base.

chewbacca.name: Chewbacca
chewbacca.bio: A Wookiee warrior over two hundred years old, who fought beside Yoda in the Clone Wars and then became Han Solo's co-pilot and lifelong friend after Han freed him on Mimban. Loyal, fierce and a brilliant mechanic, he flew the Falcon for decades and received the medal he missed out on after the Battle of Yavin.

obi-wan-kenobi.name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
obi-wan-kenobi.bio: Qui-Gon Jinn's apprentice, who took on young Anakin Skywalker and became his master, brother and friend. After Anakin fell he left him burning on Mustafar and went into exile on Tatooine to watch over Luke. As old Ben Kenobi he gave Luke his father's lightsaber, then let Vader strike him down to become one with the Force.

anakin-skywalker.name: Anakin Skywalker
anakin-skywalker.bio: A slave boy from Tatooine who might be the Chosen One of Jedi prophecy. He became a Jedi hero of the Clone Wars, secretly married Padmé, and, terrified of losing her, fell to the dark side and became Darth Vader, the Emperor's enforcer. His son Luke never gave up on him, and in the end Anakin turned on the Emperor and saved him.

c-3po.name: C-3PO
c-3po.bio: A fussy, anxious protocol droid fluent in over six million forms of communication. Young Anakin built him from scrap on Tatooine. After his memory was wiped he spent the rest of the saga beside R2-D2, complaining all the way through the Rebellion, the Resistance and more adventures than any droid should have to bear.

r2-d2.name: R2-D2
r2-d2.bio: A brave, stubborn little astromech who saved Queen Amidala's ship on his first adventure and never stopped saving people. He carried Leia's message and the Death Star plans to Obi-Wan, flew with Luke to the Death Star and Dagobah, and holds more secrets than anyone in the saga, including the map that led Rey to Luke.

wilhuff-tarkin.name: Grand Moff Tarkin
wilhuff-tarkin.bio: A cold, ruthless Imperial governor who believed fear would keep the galaxy in line. He took control of the Death Star from Krennic, tested it on Jedha and Scarif, and destroyed Alderaan in front of Leia. He refused to evacuate the station at Yavin, sure of victory, and died when Luke's torpedoes found their mark.

yoda.name: Yoda
yoda.bio: The small, ancient Grand Master of the Jedi Order, about nine hundred years old, who trained Jedi for centuries. He duelled Count Dooku and the Emperor himself, then went into exile on Dagobah after the fall of the Republic. There he trained Luke, before passing into the Force, and still appeared to guide Luke as a spirit.

lando-calrissian.name: Lando Calrissian
lando-calrissian.bio: A smooth-talking gambler and the original owner of the Millennium Falcon, which he lost to Han in a game of sabacc. As administrator of Cloud City he betrayed Han to Vader, then turned on the Empire, rescued his friend and flew the Falcon into the second Death Star. Decades later he helped rally the galaxy to Exegol.

boba-fett.name: Boba Fett
boba-fett.bio: An unaltered clone of the bounty hunter Jango Fett, raised as his son, who saw his father killed by Mace Windu on Geonosis. He grew into the galaxy's most feared bounty hunter, caught Han Solo for Jabba, and fell into the Sarlacc pit, only to climb out years later and take over Jabba's old palace on Tatooine.

darth-sidious.name: Palpatine
darth-sidious.bio: A quiet senator from Naboo who was secretly the Sith Lord Darth Sidious. He started the Clone Wars, played both sides, became Supreme Chancellor and then Emperor, and turned Anakin Skywalker into Darth Vader. Thrown down the Death Star's reactor shaft, he somehow survived on Exegol, until Rey stood against him.

jabba-desilijic-tiure.name: Jabba the Hutt
jabba-desilijic-tiure.bio: A huge, greedy Hutt crime lord who ruled Tatooine's criminal underworld from his desert palace. He put a price on Han Solo's head, kept Han frozen in carbonite as a wall decoration, and tried to feed Luke to his rancor and the Sarlacc. Leia strangled him with the chain he had used to keep her prisoner.

wicket-wystri-warrick.name: Wicket
wicket-wystri-warrick.bio: A curious young Ewok who found Leia in the forest of Endor after a speeder bike crash and brought her to his village. Thanks to him, the Ewoks joined the Rebels against the Empire, helping to bring down the shield generator protecting the second Death Star.

qui-gon-jinn.name: Qui-Gon Jinn
qui-gon-jinn.bio: A wise Jedi Master who followed the Force rather than the Council's rules. He found young Anakin on Tatooine, freed him and insisted he be trained. He was killed by Darth Maul on Naboo, but he had learned how to keep his identity after death, and later taught Yoda and Obi-Wan how to become one with the Force.

padme-amidala.name: Padmé Amidala
padme-amidala.bio: Elected Queen of Naboo at fourteen, she fought to free her planet from the Trade Federation, then became a senator who tried to stop the Clone Wars through diplomacy. She secretly married Anakin Skywalker. After his fall she died giving birth to the twins Luke and Leia, still believing there was good in him.

jar-jar-binks.name: Jar Jar Binks
jar-jar-binks.bio: A clumsy Gungan outcast whose life was saved by Qui-Gon, and who joined the Jedi on their adventure. He helped unite the Gungans with the Naboo, became a representative in the Senate, and, without meaning to, proposed giving Chancellor Palpatine the emergency powers he needed to become Emperor.

maul.name: Darth Maul
maul.bio: Darth Sidious's red-and-black tattooed apprentice, with a double-bladed lightsaber. He killed Qui-Gon Jinn on Naboo and was cut in half by Obi-Wan, but survived on hatred and robotic legs. He later took over Mandalore and led the Crimson Dawn syndicate, until he finally fell to Obi-Wan on Tatooine.

mace-windu.name: Mace Windu
mace-windu.bio: One of the greatest Jedi Masters of the Order, with a purple lightsaber and a fighting style that drew close to the dark side. He led the Jedi charge on Geonosis and killed Jango Fett. When he went to arrest Palpatine, he had the Sith Lord beaten until Anakin turned on him.

shmi-skywalker-lars.name: Shmi Skywalker
shmi-skywalker-lars.bio: Anakin's mother, a slave on Tatooine who raised him alone and let him go with the Jedi to give him a better life. She was later freed and married the farmer Cliegg Lars. When Tusken Raiders kidnapped her, Anakin came too late, and her death in his arms set him on his dark path.

dooku.name: Count Dooku
dooku.bio: A Jedi Master and nobleman who left the Order, became Darth Tyranus, Sidious's apprentice, and led the Separatists in the Clone Wars. He cut off Anakin's arm on Geonosis, duelled Yoda and fled. On the Invisible Hand, Palpatine had Anakin kill him.

jango-fett.name: Jango Fett
jango-fett.bio: The bounty hunter chosen to be the template for the Republic's clone army. As his payment he asked for one unaltered clone to raise as his son, Boba. He fought Obi-Wan on Kamino and was killed by Mace Windu in the Geonosis arena.

grievous.name: General Grievous
grievous.bio: A cyborg general of the Separatist droid armies, with a terrible cough and a collection of lightsabers taken from fallen Jedi. He kidnapped Chancellor Palpatine at the start of Revenge of the Sith and fought Obi-Wan with four arms on Utapau, until Obi-Wan finished him with a blaster.

bail-prestor-organa.name: Bail Organa
bail-prestor-organa.bio: The senator of Alderaan, one of the founders of the Rebellion, and Leia's adopted father. He was a friend to the Jedi, rescued Yoda after Order 66, and raised Leia as his own daughter. He died when the Death Star destroyed Alderaan.

owen-lars.name: Owen Lars
owen-lars.bio: Anakin's stepbrother, a moisture farmer on Tatooine who raised Luke as his nephew with his wife Beru, wanting to keep him safe and away from the Jedi. Stormtroopers searching for the droids killed them both.

reva-sevander.name: Reva
reva-sevander.bio: The Third Sister, a ruthless Inquisitor obsessed with finding Obi-Wan Kenobi. She was secretly one of the younglings who survived Anakin's attack on the Jedi Temple during Order 66, and her real target was Darth Vader himself.

grand-inquisitor.name: The Grand Inquisitor
grand-inquisitor.bio: The leader of the Inquisitors, the Empire's hunters of surviving Jedi, and once a Jedi Temple Guard himself. He hunted Obi-Wan and later the rebels of the Ghost, until he lost a duel to Kanan Jarrus.

fifth-brother.name: The Fifth Brother
fifth-brother.bio: A tall, powerful Inquisitor who hunted the last Jedi alongside the Grand Inquisitor, appearing in Obi-Wan Kenobi and Rebels.

tala-durith.name: Tala Durith
tala-durith.bio: An Imperial officer disgusted by the Empire's cruelty who secretly helped the Path smuggle Jedi to safety. She sheltered Obi-Wan and Leia on Mapuzo and gave her life at the Path's base on Jabiim so the others could escape.

jyn-erso.name: Jyn Erso
jyn-erso.bio: The daughter of Galen Erso, raised by the extremist Saw Gerrera after her mother was killed and her father taken by the Empire. A prisoner when the Rebels found her, she led the mission that stole the Death Star plans from Scarif. 'Rebellions are built on hope.'

cassian-jeron-andor.name: Cassian Andor
cassian-jeron-andor.bio: A thief from Ferrix who became one of the Rebellion's most dedicated agents, willing to do terrible things for the cause. After the Aldhani heist and escaping an Imperial prison, he gave everything to the Rebellion, and died on Scarif alongside Jyn after the plans were sent.

k-2so.name: K-2SO
k-2so.bio: An Imperial security droid reprogrammed by Cassian Andor, who says exactly what he thinks, usually the odds of failure. He fought his way through the Citadel tower on Scarif to buy Jyn and Cassian time.

chirrut-imwe.name: Chirrut Îmwe
chirrut-imwe.bio: A blind warrior monk of the Guardians of the Whills, who once guarded the Kyber Temple on Jedha. A believer in the Force, though not a Jedi, he walked through blaster fire on Scarif chanting 'I am one with the Force, and the Force is with me.'

baze-malbus.name: Baze Malbus
baze-malbus.bio: Chirrut's closest friend and protector, a former Guardian of the Whills who lost his faith and swapped it for a huge repeating blaster. After Chirrut died on Scarif, Baze took up his words and walked out to join him.

bodhi-rook.name: Bodhi Rook
bodhi-rook.bio: An Imperial cargo pilot who defected to carry Galen Erso's message to the Rebels. He flew the stolen shuttle on the mission to Scarif, named it Rogue One, and connected the stolen plans to the fleet before he died.

orson-callan-krennic.name: Director Krennic
orson-callan-krennic.bio: The ambitious director of the Death Star project, who forced Galen Erso to build it. He hoped it would win him the Emperor's favour, but Tarkin took the credit. Krennic died on Scarif when the Death Star fired on its own archive.

saw-gerrera.name: Saw Gerrera
saw-gerrera.bio: A veteran fighter who learned rebellion in the Clone Wars on Onderon, then waged a brutal guerrilla war against the Empire. Too extreme for the other rebels, he raised the young Jyn Erso, and died on Jedha as the Death Star's blast swept over it.

galen-walton-erso.name: Galen Erso
galen-walton-erso.bio: A brilliant scientist forced by Krennic to design the Death Star's superlaser. He secretly built a weakness into the station and sent word to the Rebels, then died in his daughter Jyn's arms on Eadu.

qi-ra.name: Qi'ra
qi-ra.bio: Han Solo's childhood love from the streets of Corellia, separated from him when he escaped. She became a lieutenant of the Crimson Dawn syndicate, and in the end chose to take its leadership rather than leave with Han, answering to Maul himself.

tobias-beckett.name: Tobias Beckett
tobias-beckett.bio: A veteran thief who took young Han under his wing on Mimban and taught him to trust no one. He led the doomed coaxium heists for Dryden Vos, betrayed Han, and was shot by him in their final confrontation.

dryden-vos.name: Dryden Vos
dryden-vos.bio: A charming but deadly crime lord of the Crimson Dawn syndicate who ran his business from his luxury yacht, the First Light. He gave Han's crew one last chance to make good, and was killed by Qi'ra.

l3-37.name: L3-37
l3-37.bio: Lando's self-built droid co-pilot, a fierce campaigner for droid rights. She freed the droids in Kessel's mines, was fatally damaged, and her memory was uploaded into the Millennium Falcon's navigation computer, helping Han make the Kessel Run.

enfys-nest.name: Enfys Nest
enfys-nest.bio: The masked leader of the Cloud-Riders, a band of marauders who turn out to be fighting the crime syndicates rather than serving them. On Savareen she revealed herself as a young woman fighting for the beginnings of a rebellion.

mitth-raw-nuruodo.name: Grand Admiral Thrawn
mitth-raw-nuruodo.bio: A brilliant Chiss strategist who studies his enemies' art to understand how they think. He hunted the rebels in Rebels until Ezra Bridger called space whales to drag his flagship away. Stranded in another galaxy for years, he returns in Ahsoka, ready to rebuild the Empire.

ezra-bridger.name: Ezra Bridger
ezra-bridger.bio: A street kid from Lothal who joined the crew of the Ghost and became Kanan Jarrus's Jedi apprentice. To free his homeworld he sacrificed himself, vanishing with Thrawn into another galaxy. Sabine Wren and Ahsoka set out to bring him home.

hera-syndulla.name: Hera Syndulla
hera-syndulla.bio: The Twi'lek pilot and captain of the Ghost, leader of the Rebels crew and a general in the Rebellion and New Republic. Daughter of the freedom fighter Cham Syndulla, she raised her son Jacen, Kanan's son, and never gave up looking for Ezra.

sabine-wren.name: Sabine Wren
sabine-wren.bio: A Mandalorian artist and explosives expert from the Ghost crew. She helped unite Mandalore's clans, and, after the war, trained with Ahsoka Tano as a Jedi apprentice, setting out to find her missing friend Ezra.

ahsoka-tano.name: Ahsoka Tano
ahsoka-tano.bio: Anakin Skywalker's apprentice in the Clone Wars, who left the Jedi Order after being framed for a crime. She survived Order 66, helped the rebels of the Ghost, duelled her old master Darth Vader, and later hunts Grand Admiral Thrawn across two galaxies.

baylan-skoll.name: Baylan Skoll
baylan-skoll.bio: A former Jedi who survived Order 66 and lost faith in the Order, now a mercenary with his own plans for the galaxy's future. He and his apprentice Shin Hati helped Morgan Elsbeth reach Peridea, chasing a power older than the Jedi and Sith.

shin-hati.name: Shin Hati
shin-hati.bio: Baylan Skoll's apprentice, a skilled and ambitious fighter who serves alongside him as a mercenary for Morgan Elsbeth and clashes with Sabine Wren, eventually striking out on her own on Peridea.

morgan-elsbeth.name: Morgan Elsbeth
morgan-elsbeth.bio: A Nightsister survivor of Dathomir's destruction who became an Imperial industrialist and Thrawn's loyal ally. As magistrate of Corvus she clashed with Ahsoka, and later she built the ship and found the way to bring Thrawn home.

huyang.name: Huyang
huyang.bio: An ancient droid who has taught Jedi younglings to build their lightsabers for thousands of years, including Ahsoka. He travels with her in Ahsoka, with an encyclopaedic memory and plenty of opinions.

wim.name: Wim
wim.bio: A daydreaming boy from At Attin who wants nothing more than to be a Jedi. He finds the buried pirate ship Onyx Cinder in the woods and accidentally launches himself and his friends into a galaxy-wide adventure.

neel.name: Neel
neel.bio: Wim's best friend, a gentle, blue elephant-like boy who is happy to follow along on adventures but is always ready to admit he'd rather be home.

fern.name: Fern
fern.bio: A bold, rebellious girl from At Attin and the natural leader of the group, daughter of a government official, who always wants to be in charge of the adventure.

kb.name: KB
kb.bio: Fern's quiet, clever best friend, who has cybernetic implants and is the best of the kids at fixing machines and working out what's going on.

sm-33.name: SM-33
sm-33.bio: A battered old pirate droid, first mate of the Onyx Cinder, who wakes up when the kids find the ship and decides to serve its new 'captain', with a habit of wanting to fight everyone.

jod-na-nawood.name: Jod Na Nawood
jod-na-nawood.bio: A pirate with many names, including Crimson Jack and Captain Silvo, who has some talent with the Force. He joins the kids claiming to be a Jedi, but really has his eye on the treasure of At Attin.

din-djarin.name: Din Djarin
din-djarin.bio: The Mandalorian, a foundling raised by the Mandalorians who never removes his helmet. A bounty hunter who was meant to deliver a child to the Empire, he instead protected him, became his father, and the two of them became Din Djarin and Grogu.

grogu.name: Grogu
grogu.bio: A small green child of Yoda's species, raised in the Jedi Temple and rescued during Order 66. Strong with the Force and fond of frogs, he was found by the Mandalorian, trained briefly by Luke, and chose to stay with Din Djarin as his apprentice and son.

rey.name: Rey
rey.bio: A scavenger from Jakku who waited years for a family that never came back. Strong in the Force, she found Luke Skywalker on Ahch-To and learned she was Palpatine's granddaughter. She defeated him on Exegol and chose her own name: Rey Skywalker.

finn.name: Finn
finn.bio: A First Order stormtrooper, FN-2187, who refused to kill on Jakku and escaped with Poe Dameron. He became a hero of the Resistance and later found that the Force had guided his choices all along.

poe-dameron.name: Poe Dameron
poe-dameron.bio: The Resistance's best pilot, flying his X-wing Black One against the First Order. Hot-headed and brave, he learned to lead instead of only fight, and became general of the Resistance.

ben-solo.name: Kylo Ren
ben-solo.bio: The son of Han Solo and Leia Organa, who turned to the dark side and became Kylo Ren, idolising his grandfather Darth Vader. He killed his father, overthrew Snoke and led the First Order, until his mother's love brought him back as Ben Solo to save Rey.

bb-8.name: BB-8
bb-8.bio: Poe Dameron's rolling ball of a droid, who carried the map to Luke Skywalker across Jakku and into the arms of Rey. Loyal, brave and surprisingly expressive.

snoke.name: Snoke
snoke.bio: The mysterious Supreme Leader of the First Order, who turned Ben Solo to the dark side. He was secretly a creation of Palpatine's on Exegol, and Kylo Ren cut him in half in his own throne room.

armitage-hux.name: General Hux
armitage-hux.bio: A fanatical young First Order general who commanded Starkiller Base and gave the order to destroy the Hosnian system. He despised Kylo Ren so much that he eventually became a spy for the Resistance.

phasma.name: Captain Phasma
phasma.bio: The chrome-armoured commander of the First Order's stormtroopers, responsible for Finn's training, who later fought her former trooper on Snoke's flagship.

maz-kanata.name: Maz Kanata
maz-kanata.bio: A tiny, ancient pirate queen who has run a castle on Takodana for a thousand years. She kept Luke's old lightsaber in her vaults and gave Rey her first push towards her destiny.

rose-tico.name: Rose Tico
rose-tico.bio: A Resistance maintenance worker whose sister Paige died bombing a dreadnought. She joined Finn on a mission to Canto Bight and saved him on Crait, believing in saving what we love rather than fighting what we hate.

amilyn-holdo.name: Vice Admiral Holdo
amilyn-holdo.bio: A Resistance commander who took charge after Leia was injured. Mistrusted by Poe, she quietly saved the Resistance by staying aboard the Raddus and ramming it through Snoke's flagship at lightspeed.

zorii-bliss.name: Zorii Bliss
zorii-bliss.bio: The masked leader of the Spice Runners of Kijimi and Poe Dameron's old partner from his smuggling days, who helped the heroes get into the First Order's flagship.

osha-aniseya.name: Osha
osha-aniseya.bio: One of twin sisters created through the Force by a coven on Brendok, who was taken in by the Jedi after the coven was destroyed. She left the Order and worked as a mechanic, until her sister's murders dragged her back into the Jedi's world.

mae-ho-aniseya.name: Mae
mae-ho-aniseya.bio: Osha's twin, raised by the coven and taught to hate the Jedi for what happened on Brendok. She became an assassin hunting the Jedi involved, guided by a mysterious master.

sol.name: Master Sol
sol.bio: A kind, respected Jedi Master who once trained Osha and was part of the mission to Brendok. As the assassin closes in on the Jedi from that mission, he has to face what really happened there.

qimir.name: Qimir
qimir.bio: Also called the Stranger, a former Jedi Padawan turned Sith who poses as a harmless smuggler while secretly training Mae. He hides on the ocean world of Bal'demnic.

jecki-lon.name: Jecki Lon
jecki-lon.bio: Master Sol's calm, skilled Padawan, who joins the hunt for the assassin and fights bravely when the mission turns deadly.

yord-fandar.name: Yord Fandar
yord-fandar.bio: A by-the-book Jedi Knight and old friend of Osha's from her days as a Padawan, who goes with Master Sol on the hunt for the assassin.

indara.name: Master Indara
indara.bio: A Jedi Master who led the mission to Brendok, and the first target of the assassin, ambushed in a cantina on Ueda.

vernestra-rwoh.name: Vernestra Rwoh
vernestra-rwoh.bio: A Jedi Master of the High Republic who became a Jedi Knight at just fifteen. In The Acolyte she sits on the Jedi Council, and the Stranger has a connection to her past.

rex.name: Captain Rex
rex.bio: CT-7567, captain of the 501st Legion and Anakin's right hand through the Clone Wars, and the clone who came closest to Ahsoka. When Order 66 came he fought his own chip long enough to tell her to find Fives, and they survived together. Years later he came out of retirement on Seelos to fight for the Rebellion.

plo-koon.name: Plo Koon
plo-koon.bio: A gentle Jedi Master in a breathing mask who found the infant Ahsoka on Shili and brought her to the Temple. He led his clone Wolfpack from the cockpit of his own fighter and was loved by his men, until they shot him down over Cato Neimoidia at Order 66.

asajj-ventress.name: Asajj Ventress
asajj-ventress.bio: A Nightsister orphan trained as a Jedi, then as Count Dooku's assassin with twin curved lightsabers. Dooku betrayed her, Grievous wiped out her sisters, and she became a bounty hunter who helped Ahsoka and loved Quinlan Vos. After the war she was still out there, protecting the Jedi who had survived.

cody.name: Commander Cody
cody.bio: CC-2224, Obi-Wan's loyal clone commander of the 212th Attack Battalion, steady, clever and dryly funny. He fought beside Obi-Wan on Christophsis, Ryloth and Utapau, where he gave the order to fire on him when Order 66 came.

barriss-offee.name: Barriss Offee
barriss-offee.bio: Luminara Unduli's serious, gifted Padawan, and Ahsoka's friend through the brain-worm horrors of Geonosis. Losing faith in a Jedi Order at war, she bombed the Temple and let Ahsoka take the blame. Freed from prison by the Empire, she refused to become an Inquisitor and found a quiet life as a healer.

luminara-unduli.name: Luminara Unduli
luminara-unduli.bio: A calm, precise Jedi Master with tattoos across her face, Barriss Offee's teacher. She guarded the captive Nute Gunray, fought on Geonosis and Kashyyyk, and was caught by the Empire after Order 66. Even her death was used against the Jedi: the Inquisitor kept her image alive to lure survivors to the Spire.

ki-adi-mundi.name: Ki-Adi-Mundi
ki-adi-mundi.bio: A tall-domed Jedi Master on the High Council, thoughtful and a little proud. He led the ground assault on the second battle of Geonosis, raced Anakin to the droid factory, and fell on Mygeeto when his clones turned on him at Order 66.

poggle-the-lesser.name: Poggle the Lesser
poggle-the-lesser.bio: Archduke of Geonosis, whose droid foundries armed the Separatist army. After the first battle he rebuilt the factories, and in the second battle of Geonosis the Jedi had to capture him to find the Geonosian queen. He was killed on Mustafar with the rest of the Separatist Council.

satine-kryze.name: Satine Kryze
satine-kryze.bio: The pacifist Duchess of Mandalore, who led her people away from their warrior past and kept her world neutral in the Clone Wars. She and Obi-Wan had loved each other long before, and the feeling never quite went away. Maul killed her in front of him to break him.

cad-bane.name: Cad Bane
cad-bane.bio: The galaxy's most feared bounty hunter, with a wide-brimmed hat, rocket boots and a slow, menacing drawl. He held the Senate hostage, stole a holocron from inside the Jedi Temple and kidnapped Force-sensitive children for Sidious. Decades later Boba Fett finally outdrew him on Tatooine.

aurra-sing.name: Aurra Sing
aurra-sing.bio: A pale, chalk-white bounty hunter with a long sniper rifle and an antenna in her head. After Jango's death she took charge of the young Boba Fett, helping him try to kill Mace Windu, and she ran with Cad Bane and the Hutts through the war.

lux-bonteri.name: Lux Bonteri
lux-bonteri.bio: The son of a Separatist senator who wanted peace. After Dooku had his mother killed, Lux turned against the Separatists, briefly trusted Death Watch, and then led the rebellion that freed Onderon with Saw and Steela Gerrera. Ahsoka was very fond of him.

savage-opress.name: Savage Opress
savage-opress.bio: A Nightbrother transformed by Mother Talzin's magic into a towering, horned warrior and sent to Dooku as an apprentice and assassin. Sent to find his lost brother, he brought Maul back from Lotho Minor, and fought beside him until Darth Sidious killed him on Mandalore.

talzin.name: Mother Talzin
talzin.bio: The witch-queen of the Nightsisters of Dathomir and the mother of Maul, wielding dark, ancient magick. She plotted for years against Dooku and Sidious, rebuilt Maul's mind and body, and was finally killed by Grievous's blade while trying to take Dooku's place.

father-mortis.name: The Father
father-mortis.bio: The ancient guardian of Mortis, who held his children, the light Daughter and the dark Son, in balance. Old and dying, he called Anakin there to test whether he truly was the Chosen One, and hoped he would take his place.

daughter.name: The Daughter
daughter.bio: The embodiment of the light side of the Force on Mortis, gentle and bright. She gave her own life force to bring Ahsoka back after the Son killed her, a gift that stayed with Ahsoka for the rest of her life.

son.name: The Son
son.bio: The embodiment of the dark side on Mortis, able to take the shape of a winged gargoyle. He showed Anakin his future as Darth Vader and longed to escape Mortis, until his own father killed him.

even-piell.name: Even Piell
even-piell.bio: A small, scarred and very tough Jedi Master on the High Council. Captured with Captain Tarkin and held in the Citadel, he shared half of a vital secret route with Tarkin before he died on Lola Sayu during the rescue.

lee-char.name: Prince Lee-Char
lee-char.bio: The young heir to the throne of Mon Cala, unsure of himself after his father's murder. During the Quarren rebellion and the Separatist invasion he found his courage, united both peoples and became king, with Captain Ackbar beside him.

kit-fisto.name: Kit Fisto
kit-fisto.bio: A cheerful Nautolan Jedi Master with head-tentacles and a wide grin, at home under water. He fought in the oceans of Mon Cala, survived Grievous's lair, and fell in Palpatine's office alongside Mace Windu when the Jedi tried to arrest the Chancellor.

fives.name: Fives
fives.bio: CT-5555, a cadet of Domino Squad who became an ARC trooper in the 501st. Investigating why his friend Tup killed a Jedi, he found the inhibitor chips in every clone's head and the plot behind them. No one believed him, and he was shot before he could warn anyone.

pong-krell.name: Pong Krell
pong-krell.bio: A four-armed Jedi general who took command of the 501st on Umbara and sent its clones on suicidal attacks. He had seen the Jedi's fall coming and secretly turned to the dark side; when Rex's men discovered his treachery, they arrested him and Dogma shot him.

steela-gerrera.name: Steela Gerrera
steela-gerrera.bio: Saw's older sister, a natural leader and sharpshooter who took command of Onderon's rebels and freed their world from its Separatist king. In the final battle she fell from a cliff, and Ahsoka could not hold on to her.

hondo-ohnaka.name: Hondo Ohnaka
hondo-ohnaka.bio: A charming, greedy, endlessly talkative pirate who captured Count Dooku, Anakin and Obi-Wan in a single week and somehow never stopped being likeable. Years later he was still around, still scheming, and still claiming to be Ezra's good friend.

pre-vizsla.name: Pre Vizsla
pre-vizsla.bio: The leader of Death Watch and owner of the Darksaber, the black blade of ancient Mandalorian rulers. He wanted to bring back Mandalore's warrior past and overthrow Satine, and allied with Maul to do it, until Maul took the Darksaber and his head in single combat.

bo-katan-kryze.name: Bo-Katan Kryze
bo-katan-kryze.bio: Satine's fierce younger sister, a Death Watch lieutenant who turned on Maul when he took Mandalore. She fought beside Ahsoka in the siege of Mandalore, led the clans against the Empire, and years later united the scattered Mandalorians to retake their homeworld.

trace-martez.name: Trace Martez
trace-martez.bio: A young pilot and mechanic from Coruscant's lower levels, who fixes ships and dreams of flying away. Ahsoka crashed into her life after leaving the Jedi Order, and the friendship that began with a broken speeder survived spice runners, Pykes and the fall of the Republic.

rafa-martez.name: Rafa Martez
rafa-martez.bio: Trace's older sister, a sharp-tongued schemer who always has a deal on the go. Her spice-running job for the Pykes nearly got them all killed, but she and Ahsoka learned to trust each other, and the sisters stood by Ahsoka when the Republic fell.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.bio: The leader of the Bad Batch, a clone with super-sensitive senses who can track anything. When the Empire rose he refused its orders and took on the care of Omega, becoming as much her father as her sergeant.

echo.name: Echo
echo.bio: Once a by-the-book trooper from Domino Squad, thought killed at the Citadel. The Separatists kept him alive as a half-machine computer, until Rex and the Bad Batch rescued him on Skako Minor. He joined them, then left to help other clones escape the Empire.

kanan-jarrus.name: Kanan Jarrus
kanan-jarrus.bio: Caleb Dume, a Padawan who survived Order 66 and hid as a drifter with a new name. Hera brought him back into the fight, and he became Ezra's master. Blinded by Maul on Malachor, he learned to see through the Force, and gave his life on Lothal to save Hera and their unborn son.

garazeb-orrelios.name: Zeb
garazeb-orrelios.bio: Garazeb Orrelios, a huge, grumpy Lasat warrior and former Honor Guard of Lasan, whose world the Empire burned. The Ghost crew's muscle, Ezra's grudging roommate, and in the end the one who made peace with Kallus, the man who destroyed his people.

c1-10p.name: Chopper
c1-10p.bio: Chopper, Hera's grumpy, cranky old astromech, built from mismatched parts and proud of it. He electrocutes his friends, cheats at games and complains constantly, but he has saved the Ghost crew more times than any of them like to admit.

alexsandr-kallus.name: Agent Kallus
alexsandr-kallus.bio: An Imperial Security Bureau agent who hunted the Ghost crew across Lothal, carrying a bo-rifle taken from a Lasat warrior. Stranded on an icy moon with Zeb, he began to doubt, became the rebel spy Fulcrum, and finally joined the Rebellion openly.

maketh-tua.name: Minister Tua
maketh-tua.bio: Lothal's Imperial minister, a careerist who kept the planet's factories running for the Empire. After too many failures against the rebels she tried to defect and asked the Ghost crew to get her off Lothal, but she was killed before she could escape.

seventh-sister.name: The Seventh Sister
seventh-sister.bio: A cold, playful Inquisitor who hunted Ezra with her spidery probe droids and her spinning lightsaber. She and the Fifth Brother fought the rebels over Garel and Malachor, where Maul killed her.

bendu.name: The Bendu
bendu.bio: An enormous, ancient creature on Atollon who stands between the light and the dark side of the Force. He taught the blinded Kanan to see again, then lost patience with the war on his world and scattered both rebels and Empire with a storm.

arihnda-pryce.name: Governor Pryce
arihnda-pryce.bio: A Lothal mining heiress who rose to become the planet's Imperial governor. Ruthless and ambitious, she brought in Grand Admiral Thrawn to destroy the rebels and ordered Lothal's fuel depot blown up rather than lose it, the blast that killed Kanan. She died in the liberation of Lothal.

rukh.name: Rukh
rukh.bio: Thrawn's silent Noghri bodyguard and assassin, a master tracker who moves almost invisibly. He hunted the rebels across Lothal for his master, and was finally caught in the shield of the Imperial complex during the liberation of Lothal.

mon-mothma.name: Mon Mothma
mon-mothma.bio: A senator from Chandrila who opposed Palpatine's war powers from the start. For years she secretly funded the rebellion while playing the loyal senator, until she denounced the Emperor in the Senate and fled, becoming the leader of the Rebel Alliance.

luthen-rael.name: Luthen Rael
luthen-rael.bio: An antiques dealer on Coruscant and, in secret, the man building the rebellion one cell at a time. He used anyone and sacrificed anything, himself included, to light the fire. He recruited Cassian for the Aldhani heist and paid for it all with his own life.

dedra-meero.name: Dedra Meero
dedra-meero.bio: A brilliant, ambitious ISB supervisor who was the first Imperial to see that the scattered rebel attacks were connected. She hunted the man she called Axis, ran the Ghorman project, and was brought down by her own obsession.

syril-karn.name: Syril Karn
syril-karn.bio: A rigid, ambitious corporate deputy inspector humiliated by Cassian on Ferrix, who spent years trying to catch him. He fell for Dedra Meero, went undercover for the ISB on Ghorman, and died there when he finally understood what the Empire was.

bix-caleen.name: Bix Caleen
bix-caleen.bio: A salvage dealer on Ferrix and Cassian's on-and-off love, who passed his messages to Luthen. Tortured by the ISB, she slowly rebuilt herself with Cassian's help, and at the end she carried his future away to safety.

kleya-marki.name: Kleya Marki
kleya-marki.bio: Luthen's assistant in his antiques shop and in everything else: his partner in building the rebellion, raised by him since childhood. Cool, clever and unflinching, she kept the network alive when Luthen fell and passed the warning about the Death Star to Yavin.

vel-sartha.name: Vel Sartha
vel-sartha.bio: Mon Mothma's cousin, a rich girl turned rebel who led the heist team on Aldhani. Later she became a leader of the rebel cell on Yavin, and the partner of Cinta Kaz.

b2emo.name: B2EMO
b2emo.bio: Bee, the old, slow-talking salvage droid of Maarva Andor's household on Ferrix, who adored Cassian and Maarva. Nervous and loyal, he stayed with the people of Ferrix through the uprising and later rebuilt his life with the rebels.

omega.name: Omega
omega.bio: A young clone girl raised on Kamino, one of the few unaltered copies of Jango Fett. She escaped with the Bad Batch, became their sister and their heart, and was hunted by the Empire for the value of her blood until her family freed her and the other children from Mount Tantiss.

wrecker.name: Wrecker
wrecker.bio: The Bad Batch's huge, cheerful demolitions expert, who loves explosions and his stuffed toy Lula. He is the strongest clone in the squad and the softest with Omega.

tech.name: Tech
tech.bio: The Bad Batch's genius, with goggles and an answer for everything, who can hack any computer and fly anything. He fell during a mission on Eriadu, and was later found alive as a captive at Mount Tantiss.

crosshair.name: Crosshair
crosshair.bio: The Bad Batch's sharpshooter, who obeyed his inhibitor chip and his orders and joined the Empire, hunting his own brothers. Slowly he realised the Empire would never value the clones, and he came back to his squad for the last fight at Mount Tantiss.

ciddarin-scaleback.name: Cid
ciddarin-scaleback.bio: A former Jedi informant who runs a dingy parlour on Ord Mantell, taking jobs and handing out dangerous work to the Bad Batch for a cut. Shrewd and greedy, she cared about them more than she admitted, until she sold them out.

royce-hemlock.name: Dr. Royce Hemlock
royce-hemlock.bio: The Empire's chief scientist at Mount Tantiss, cold and polite, running Project Necromancer's clone experiments for Palpatine. He wanted Omega's blood and anyone else's that would serve, until the Bad Batch came for the children he was holding.

nala-se.name: Nala Se
nala-se.bio: The Kaminoan chief medical scientist who looked after the clones from birth, and who secretly kept Omega safe. She knew the truth about the inhibitor chips, helped hide it from Fives, and paid with her freedom to protect the girl she raised.

edmon-rampart.name: Admiral Rampart
edmon-rampart.bio: An Imperial vice admiral who replaced the clones with recruited stormtroopers and ordered the destruction of Kamino's cloning city to cover it up. He was exposed and arrested when the Bad Batch released the recordings.

fennec-shand.name: Fennec Shand
fennec-shand.bio: An elite assassin left for dead on Tatooine, rebuilt by Boba Fett and sworn to his service. She became his right hand, then his partner in running Jabba's old territory in Mos Espa.

greef-karga.name: Greef Karga
greef-karga.bio: The head of the guild of bounty hunters on Nevarro, who gave Din Djarin the job that led to Grogu. After a rocky start he became a true friend, cleaned up Nevarro and became its high magistrate.

gideon.name: Moff Gideon
gideon.bio: An Imperial warlord with the Darksaber, hunting Grogu for the power in his blood. He chased Din Djarin across the Outer Rim, captured Grogu, and returned for one last attempt to destroy the Mandalorians on Mandalore itself.

carasynthia-dune.name: Cara Dune
carasynthia-dune.bio: A former Rebel shock trooper from Alderaan who drifted after the war, until she met Din Djarin on Sorgan. She fought beside him to protect Grogu and became a marshal of the New Republic on Nevarro.

the-armorer.name: The Armorer
the-armorer.bio: The leader and blacksmith of Din Djarin's covert of Mandalorians, who forges their beskar armour and keeps their ways. She sent Din to find the Jedi for Grogu, and later forged Grogu's own armour.

kuiil.name: Kuiil
kuiil.bio: An old Ugnaught moisture farmer who had served out his time as an Imperial indentured worker, and who only wanted peace. He helped Din Djarin find and later protect Grogu, rebuilt IG-11 to care for him, and died saving the child. "I have spoken."

ig-11.name: IG-11
ig-11.bio: A cold assassin droid sent after Grogu and shot by Din Djarin. Rebuilt by Kuiil as a nurse droid, he became Grogu's protector and gave his own life for him on Nevarro; later his parts helped protect the town as its marshal.

fourth-sister.name: The Fourth Sister
fourth-sister.bio: An Inquisitor, once a Jedi herself, who recruited Barriss Offee into the Inquisitorius and trained her. She later joined the hunt for Obi-Wan Kenobi.

jocasta-nu.name: Jocasta Nu
jocasta-nu.bio: The Jedi Order's chief librarian, guardian of the Temple archives, who once insisted that if something was not in the archives, it did not exist. She was an old friend of Dooku and remembered him as he had been.

yaddle.name: Yaddle
yaddle.bio: A small Jedi Master of Yoda's species who sat on the High Council. She worried about Dooku's growing anger, discovered that he had turned to the dark side, and died fighting him rather than let it pass.

lyco-strata.name: Lyco Strata
lyco-strata.bio: A young Jedi Padawan who survived Order 66 and was hiding from the Empire when Asajj Ventress found him. She took him under her protection on a dangerous journey toward the Path, the network that helped Jedi escape.

quinlan-vos.name: Quinlan Vos
quinlan-vos.bio: A rule-bending Jedi Master who can read memories from objects he touches. He was sent to kill Dooku with Asajj Ventress, fell in love with her, was pulled to the dark side and saved by her sacrifice.

durge.name: Durge
durge.bio: A huge, nearly unkillable Gen'Dai bounty hunter in armour, who could survive almost any wound by pulling himself back together. In the early Clone Wars he served the Separatists, chasing Obi-Wan through the battle of Muunilinst.

shaak-ti.name: Shaak Ti
shaak-ti.bio: A calm, graceful Togruta Jedi Master on the High Council, who watched over the clones' training on Kamino and defended them as if they were her own. In the Battle of Coruscant she protected the Chancellor from General Grievous.

firmus-piett.name: Admiral Piett
firmus-piett.bio: First officer of Vader's flagship, the Executor. When Admiral Ozzel bungled the attack on Hoth, Vader choked him and promoted Piett on the spot. A careful officer who learned to survive Vader's temper, he commanded the Executor at Endor and died when a crippled A-wing crashed into its bridge.

lobot.name: Lobot
lobot.bio: Lando Calrissian's quiet aide on Cloud City, wired into the city's computers by a cybernetic implant around his head. He rarely spoke, but he was fiercely loyal to Lando, and when the Empire took over Cloud City he led the city's security guards to help Leia and Chewbacca escape.

wedge-antilles.name: Wedge Antilles
wedge-antilles.bio: A Corellian pilot who flew with Luke at the Battle of Yavin, fought on Hoth as Rogue Three and helped Lando blow up the second Death Star at Endor. One of the few rebel pilots to survive all three great battles, he became a legend of the Alliance and later trained new pilots for the New Republic.

beru-whitesun-lars.name: Beru Lars
beru-whitesun-lars.bio: Owen Lars' wife, who raised Luke on their moisture farm on Tatooine and saw more of his father in him than Owen liked. She gently argued that Luke should be allowed to leave and become a pilot. Stormtroopers hunting the stolen Death Star plans burned the farm and killed her and Owen.

biggs-darklighter.name: Biggs Darklighter
biggs-darklighter.bio: Luke's best friend from Tatooine. He went to the Imperial Academy, defected to the Rebellion and flew as Red Three at the Battle of Yavin, where he was overjoyed to find Luke among the pilots. He covered Luke's run down the Death Star trench and was shot down by Vader moments before the end.

saun-dann.name: Trader Saun Dann
saun-dann.bio: A cheerful trader who sold goods to the Wookiees of Kashyyyk and quietly helped the Rebellion. On Life Day, with Imperial troops searching Chewbacca's family home, he dropped in with presents and talked the soldiers round, buying the family time until Chewbacca and Han could arrive.

mallatobuck.name: Malla
mallatobuck.bio: Chewbacca's wife, who waits for him at their tree house on Kashyyyk with their son Lumpy and his father Itchy. On Life Day she worries whether Chewie will make it home through the Imperial blockade, keeps the family going while stormtroopers search the house, and welcomes Han and Chewie at last.

lumpawaroo.name: Lumpy
lumpawaroo.bio: Chewbacca and Malla's young son, called Lumpy. He waits impatiently for his father to come home for Life Day, watches holo-cartoons to pass the time and outwits an Imperial trooper by building a translator to fake an order calling him back to base.

attichitcuk.name: Itchy
attichitcuk.bio: Chewbacca's elderly father, known as Itchy. A veteran of the Battle of Kashyyyk in the Clone Wars, he lives with Malla and Lumpy and spends Life Day waiting with them for Chewbacca to come home through the Imperial blockade.

gial-ackbar.name: Admiral Ackbar
gial-ackbar.bio: A Mon Calamari admiral and brilliant tactician who led the rebel fleet at Endor from his flagship Home One. When the fleet arrived to find the Death Star shield still up and the Imperial fleet waiting, he was the first to realise it was a trap. He served the Rebellion and the Resistance for decades.

quarsh-panaka.name: Captain Panaka
quarsh-panaka.bio: Head of Queen Amidala's security. When the Trade Federation invaded Naboo he got the Queen off the planet, through the blockade to Tatooine and on to Coruscant, guarding her decoy and the real queen alike. He then led the palace guards in the battle to take back Theed.

sebulba.name: Sebulba
sebulba.bio: A Dug podracer, champion of the Boonta Eve race and a notorious cheat who fitted his huge orange podracer with hidden weapons and smashed rivals off the track. He sabotaged young Anakin's pod and tried to wreck him during the race, but crashed out on the final lap as Anakin won.

watto.name: Watto
watto.bio: A Toydarian junk dealer in Mos Espa who owned Shmi and Anakin Skywalker as slaves. Jedi mind tricks did not work on him, so Qui-Gon won Anakin's freedom by betting on the Boonta Eve podrace. Watto lost his bet when Anakin won, but kept Shmi.

devon-izara.name: Devon Izara
devon-izara.bio: A Twi'lek Padawan who survived Order 66 and hid with her master, Eeko-Dio Daki, on Janix. When the Empire's Inquisitors killed him, she was taken in by Maul, who saw a chance to train an apprentice of his own, and she turned toward the dark side to get her revenge.

rook-kast.name: Rook Kast
rook-kast.bio: A Mandalorian super commando and one of Maul's most loyal followers, ever since Death Watch joined his Shadow Collective. After the Clone Wars she leads his Mandalorian warriors on Janix as he rebuilds his criminal empire under the Empire's nose.

rio-durant.name: Rio Durant
rio-durant.bio: A cheerful four-armed Ardennian pilot in Tobias Beckett's crew who welcomed Han into the gang. He flew the AT-hauler during the train heist on Vandor, where he was shot while piloting and died, leaving the crew without a pilot.

haja-estree.name: Haja Estree
haja-estree.bio: A con man on Daiyu who pretended to be a Jedi, charging desperate people for fake Force miracles. When Obi-Wan exposed him, he admitted the truth, then pointed Obi-Wan toward the kidnapped Leia and later risked his life helping the Path smuggle refugees away from the Empire.

kawlan-roken.name: Roken
kawlan-roken.bio: Leader of the Path, an underground network smuggling surviving Jedi and Force-sensitive refugees out of the Empire's reach. His wife was killed by the Inquisitors. He helped Obi-Wan and Leia escape Mapuzo and led the refugees' escape from Jabiim under Imperial fire.

eleventh-brother.name: Eleventh Brother
eleventh-brother.bio: A former Jedi turned Inquisitor, one of the Empire's Jedi hunters, who wears a stone-like mask. He was sent with Marrok to Janix to hunt down Maul and the young Jedi survivor Devon Izara.

marrok.name: Marrok
marrok.bio: A masked warrior once known as the First Brother, a Jedi who became an Inquisitor. After hunting Maul on Janix he vanished from the Inquisitorius and resurfaced in Morgan Elsbeth's service, duelling Ahsoka and Sabine until Sabine destroyed him and he dissolved in green Nightsister smoke.

brander-lawson.name: Brander Lawson
brander-lawson.bio: An honest police captain on Janix who, with his droid partner Two-Boots, tries to hold back the crime gangs flooding his city. When Maul arrives and the Empire follows him, Lawson is caught between them while trying to protect his son Rylee.

eeko-dio-daki.name: Eeko-Dio Daki
eeko-dio-daki.bio: A gentle Jedi Master who escaped Order 66 with his Padawan, Devon Izara, and hid on Janix. He tried to keep her away from anger and the dark side, but the Inquisitors found them, and his death set her on the path to Maul.

looti-vario.name: Looti Vario
looti-vario.bio: A small but ambitious Aleena crime boss on Janix who rises by allying with Maul's Shadow Collective, and ends up in the middle of a war between Maul, the Pykes and the Empire.

rylee-lawson.name: Rylee Lawson
rylee-lawson.bio: Captain Brander Lawson's young son, a keen athlete who wishes his father spent less time at work. When Maul and the Empire bring their war to Janix, Rylee's life is turned upside down along with his father's.

2b0t.name: Two-Boots
2b0t.bio: Captain Lawson's police droid partner on Janix, nicknamed Two-Boots, a dry-witted Tactical Defense Droid who backs Lawson up as the city's crime war gets out of hand.

vane.name: Vane
vane.bio: A Nikto pirate who survived the attack on Nevarro by abandoning his captain, Gorian Shard. He later turned up with Brutus' crew, and joined the hunt for the lost planet At Attin and its fabled riches.

fara.name: Fara
fara.bio: Fern's mother, a teacher and government undersecretary on At Attin. When the children vanished into space aboard the Onyx Cinder, she searched with Wim's father Wendle, and learned that her perfect planet's peace was built on secrets kept from its people.

brutus.name: Brutus
brutus.bio: A wolf-like Shistavanen pirate, first mate to the down-on-his-luck Captain Silvo until he led a mutiny and took the crew for himself. Hearing of At Attin, a lost world full of Old Republic credits, he hunted Jod Na Nawood and the children to find it.

wendle.name: Wendle
wendle.bio: Wim's father, a hard-working At Attin man who struggles to connect with his dreamy son. When Wim and the others disappear on the Onyx Cinder, he joins Fara in the search, then fights alongside the children when pirates attack.

embo.name: Embo
embo.bio: A Kyuzo bounty hunter famous for his wide-brimmed metal hat, which he throws as a weapon and uses as a shield. A Clone Wars veteran who rode with Sugi and Cad Bane, he was still hiring out his skills in the years after the Empire fell.

rotta.name: Rotta the Hutt
rotta.bio: Jabba the Hutt's son, kidnapped as a baby in the Clone Wars and rescued by Anakin and Ahsoka, who nicknamed him Stinky. Grown up and powerful, he becomes caught up in Din Djarin and Grogu's mission after the fall of the Empire.

jacen-syndulla.name: Jacen Syndulla
jacen-syndulla.bio: Hera Syndulla and the late Jedi Kanan Jarrus's son, born after the war. Force-sensitive like his father, he spends time with Ahsoka and Sabine and dreams of becoming a Jedi.

sash-ketter.name: Sash Ketter
sash-ketter.bio: A New Republic X-wing pilot in the Adelphi Rangers who flies alongside Carson Teva and his squadron.

carson-teva.name: Carson Teva
carson-teva.bio: A New Republic X-wing captain and Rebel veteran with the Adelphi Rangers. One of the few officers who took the threat of the Imperial remnant seriously, he worked with Din Djarin, Ahsoka and Hera when his superiors would not listen.

ward.name: Colonel Ward
ward.bio: A Rebel veteran and New Republic colonel who commands the Adelphi Rangers. She recruits Din Djarin to take on Imperial remnant warlords on the Outer Rim, sending him and Grogu on a dangerous new mission.

bazil.name: Bazil
bazil.bio: A small Tynnan tracker who helped the Jedi. He could sniff out a trail when no one else could, and led Sol, Osha and the others through the jungles of Khofar to find Master Kelnacca.

kelnacca.name: Kelnacca
kelnacca.bio: A Wookiee Jedi Master who lived alone in the jungles of Khofar, carrying the secret of what happened on Brendok sixteen years before. He was one of the four Jedi targeted by Mae, and was killed by the Stranger before Sol could reach him.

aniseya.name: Mother Aniseya
aniseya.bio: The leader of a coven of Force witches hiding on Brendok, who used the Force to create the twins Osha and Mae. When four Jedi arrived wanting to test the girls, she tried to keep her family together, and died the night the coven's fortress burned.

torbin.name: Torbin
torbin.bio: Master Indara's Padawan on Brendok, sixteen years before the series. Haunted by what happened there, he later withdrew into meditation and silence at the Jedi Temple, until Mae came hunting him.

koril.name: Mother Koril
koril.bio: A Zabrak witch of Brendok's coven, who carried the twins Osha and Mae and raised them with Mother Aniseya. Fiercely protective and distrustful of the Jedi, she was killed in the fire that destroyed the coven.

tera-sinube.name: Tera Sinube
tera-sinube.bio: An elderly Cosian Jedi Master with a cane that hid a lightsaber, and an expert on Coruscant's criminal underworld. He helped Ahsoka track down her stolen lightsaber and taught her that patience can beat speed.

coleman-kcaj.name: Coleman Kcaj
coleman-kcaj.bio: An Ongree Jedi Master with wide-set eyes who joined the Jedi High Council during the Clone Wars, and one of the few Jedi Masters who survived the purge that followed.

c-21-highsinger.name: C-21 Highsinger
c-21-highsinger.bio: A tall, thin bounty hunter droid of mysterious origin with twin blasters, who worked with Boba Fett's Krayt's Claw in the Clone Wars and later hunted Cad Bane's old friends as the Empire rose.

latts-razzi.name: Latts Razzi
latts-razzi.bio: A Theelin bounty hunter who fights with a grappling boa she wears like a scarf. She rode with Boba Fett's Krayt's Claw during the Clone Wars and later crossed paths with Asajj Ventress.

gilad-pellaeon.name: Captain Pellaeon
gilad-pellaeon.bio: Admiral Thrawn's loyal right-hand officer, a Clone Wars veteran who recruited promising people for Thrawn's cause. He found Morgan Elsbeth on Corvus and brought her into Thrawn's service.

wing.name: Wing
wing.bio: A man from Calodan on Corvus who knew Morgan Elsbeth when she was building her new life there. Ruled by her, his city was turned toward Imperial industry and stripped of its forests.

tay-grutty.name: Tay Grutty
tay-grutty.bio: A member of the Duros crook Lazlo's gang, which young Cad Bane joined after a casino raid. He stuck with the gang after Lazlo died and rode with Bane as he began to make his name.

niro.name: Niro
niro.bio: Cad Bane's childhood friend from the streets. When a gang raid went wrong, Niro was caught and Bane escaped. Years later Niro became a lawman, and the two old friends met again on opposite sides of the law.

crawl.title: A NEW HOPE
text: The Galactic Empire rules the galaxy through fear. A small band of rebels fights back from hidden bases.
Rebel spies have stolen the plans for the Empire's newest weapon, a battle station able to destroy an entire planet.
Now Princess Leia races home with the plans aboard her ship, as an Imperial Star Destroyer closes in behind her....

crawl.title: THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK
text: The Rebels destroyed the Death Star, but the Empire has struck back hard, hunting them from one hiding place to the next.
Luke Skywalker and his friends have taken refuge on the frozen world of Hoth, under constant watch for Imperial patrols.
Darth Vader, determined to find young Skywalker, has sent thousands of probe droids out across the galaxy....

crawl.title: RETURN OF THE JEDI
text: Luke Skywalker has come home to Tatooine to rescue his friend Han Solo from the palace of the vile gangster Jabba the Hutt.
Far away, the Empire is secretly building a second, even more powerful Death Star above the forest moon of Endor.
Once it is finished, the Emperor plans to crush the Rebellion for good. The Rebel fleet is gathering for one last stand....

crawl.title: THE PHANTOM MENACE
text: The Galactic Republic has stood for a thousand generations, but its Senate is slow and its grip on the outer worlds is slipping.
Angry at new taxes on the trade routes, the greedy Trade Federation has surrounded the peaceful planet of Naboo with a fleet of battleships, daring the Republic to stop them.
Hoping to end the crisis quietly, the Chancellor has sent two Jedi Knights to talk the Federation's leaders down....

crawl.title: THE FORCE AWAKENS
text: Luke Skywalker has disappeared. In his absence, the First Order has risen from the ashes of the Empire, determined to hunt him down.
General Leia Organa leads a small Resistance against it, hoping to find her brother and bring him back.
She has sent her best pilot to the desert world of Jakku, where an old friend may hold a clue to where Luke has gone....

crawl.title: THE LAST JEDI
text: The First Order has struck back after the loss of Starkiller Base, and the Republic it destroyed cannot help.
Supreme Leader Snoke's fleet is closing in on the Resistance as it tries to escape its base on D'Qar.
Meanwhile, Rey has found Luke Skywalker on a distant island, and hopes he will return to fight for the galaxy....

crawl.title: THE RISE OF SKYWALKER
text: A strange voice is broadcasting across the galaxy, the voice of the long-dead Emperor Palpatine.
General Leia Organa sends her agents searching for the source, while Rey continues her Jedi training.
Supreme Leader Kylo Ren hunts for the Emperor too, determined to destroy anyone who could threaten his rule....
